races.race_name: JenningsBet In Bexhill On Sea Apprentice Classified Stakes

runners.name: Spirited Dancer
runners.spotlight: Yet to add to her 2yo win but was runner-up twice in this grade in June, latterly over C&D (good to firm); didn't enjoy the run of the race when dropped back to 5.7f at Bath on Friday; might be the answer.
runners.comment: Runner-up twice in this grade in June, latterly over C&D; might be the answer

runners.name: Barnsnape Boy
runners.spotlight: Has become unreliable and was soundly beaten on latest outing a fortnight ago but won similar race to this over C&D (good) in June and has obvious claims if able to replicate that form.
runners.comment: Has become unreliable but won similar race to this over C&D in June

runners.name: River Wharfe
runners.spotlight: 8yo who has worked his way back into form this season and he won a 1m classified here yesterday under Molly Gunn, which was his sixth course win; strong claims under 4lb penalty if running again today.
runners.comment: Won 1m classified here yesterday which was his sixth course win; strong claims

runners.name: Port Hedland
runners.spotlight: Won in this grade at Bath (5.7f, good) in June but two lesser efforts have followed (6f/5f) and he's not yet proven over this far; not an easy one to predict.
runners.comment: Won in this grade in June (5.7f) but not in same form since and has stamina to prove

runners.name: Apple's Angel
runners.spotlight: Unplaced all four starts for new stable this season but was denied a clear run when fourth in this grade here (6f, good to firm) two starts ago and is probably worth another crack at 7f; could have a say.
runners.comment: 0-4 for new stable this year but was denied clear run when fourth here (6f) in June
runners.owner: P And Mrs L Rowe And John Turner

runners.name: Valadero
runners.spotlight: Still a maiden after 32 starts and sometimes races too freely but was respectable third in this grade at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm) in June, after a break, and ought to be suited by this move back up in trip.
runners.comment: Respectable third in this grade in June, after a break, and this extra furlong will suit

runners.name: Rock Master
runners.spotlight: 21-race maiden who was safely held when sixth in this grade here (1m) yesterday behind River Wharfe; he clearly needs to raise his game.
runners.comment: Safely held in this grade here yesterday behind River Wharfe and now 0-21

runners.name: Voodoo Ray
runners.spotlight: Gained four of his five wins at this track (two over 7f) but has largely been disappointing over the last couple of year and hopes of him adding to his tally are beginning to fade.
runners.comment: Largely disappointing over the last couple of year; difficult to enthuse over

races.race_name: JenningsBet Ladies Day Restricted Novice Stakes (For horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: The Monkey King
runners.spotlight: Well-bred gelding who bettered his encouraging debut when third of ten at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) last month; that form sets the standard here and he probably has more improvement to come; respected.
runners.comment: Placed at Doncaster last month, his second start, and sets the form standard here

runners.name: Regalism
runners.spotlight: Finished about 3l behind The Monkey King when fifth of ten on debut at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) 19 days ago but his inexperience was evident there and he ought to get much closer to the target here.
runners.comment: About 3l behind The Monkey King at Doncaster last month but that was an encouraging debut

runners.name: Cinq Coins
runners.spotlight: 10,000gns foal; 11th foal; brother to a Swedish 6f/1m winner, closely related to 1m-1m2f winner Menai Bridge (including 2yo; RPR 94), half-brother to four winners including Heroics (1m6f; 76); dam unplaced 7f-1m2f (58); market support will bring him into the equation.
runners.comment: 10,000gns foal; 11th foal; related to several winners; market may guide on debut
runners.owner: Groves Martin Parker Walsh And Williams

runners.name: Demonstrate
runners.spotlight: Brother to 6f Group 3 winner Sense Of Duty; 80-1, ran green and struggled on recent debut at Glorious Goodwood (6f, good); this race is easier but he still needs to take a big step forward.
runners.comment: Struggled on recent debut at Glorious Goodwood (6f)

runners.name: Foscarini
runners.spotlight: Shaped with promise when fifth of 11 at Salisbury (6f, soft) in June but didn't really build on that performance when sixth of eight at Epsom (7f, good) last month and has a bit to find with a couple of these.
runners.comment: Showed ability on both starts but has a bit to find with a couple of these

races.race_name: Jenningsbet In Hastings Handicap

runners.name: Gone Rogue
runners.spotlight: Dual course winner, latterly over 1m2f (good to firm) last month; travelled well for a long way when fourth in higher-grade company at Sandown (1m, good to firm; refitted cheekpieces) a fortnight ago and is of strong interest back at this track.
runners.comment: Won here (1m2f) last month and ran well in higher grade at Sandown (1m) two weeks later

runners.name: Boubyan
runners.spotlight: Has somewhat mixed record since joining this stable about a year ago but won on Tapeta (1m2f) in March and posted good effort when keeping-on third at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) a fortnight ago; still on a workable mark; must be considered.
runners.comment: Kept on for third at Doncaster recently and remains on a workable mark; considered

runners.name: Danehill Star
runners.spotlight: Won twice on AW (1m2f/9.4f) in early part of this year and has made the frame five consecutive times (1m-1m2f) since returned to turf in the spring; holds no secrets from the handicapper and may be better suited by 1m2f but ought to give another good account.
runners.comment: Dual AW winner in early part of year and also in good form since returned to turf

runners.name: Winemaker
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner (5f-7f) when based in Ireland; attracted stewards' attention when never-dangerous seventh on last month's stable debut at Wolverhampton (5f, AW); might well come good for Richard Hughes soon but his stamina for 1m is unproven and he's quite tricky to weigh up at the moment.
runners.comment: Never dangerous over 5f on stable debut and has stamina to prove here; tricky to weigh up

runners.name: Kondratiev Wave
runners.spotlight: Largely consistent 9yo who ended a lengthy losing run when dead-heating at Lingfield (7f, AW) in February and comes here after a pretty good second at Windsor (1m, good to firm) last month; suited by this track; likely contender.
runners.comment: Largely consistent 9yo who comes here after a good second at Windsor last month

runners.name: Dandy G Boy
runners.spotlight: Dual 7f AW winner in second half of last year but returned from layoff with two low-key turf runs in June/July (7f/7.3f); on a good mark now and might have untapped potential over 1m but others in this line-up have less to prove.
runners.comment: Returned from layoff with two low-key runs; others have less to prove

races.race_name: JenningsBet In Basingstoke Brighton Challenge Cup Handicap (The Brighton Challenge Cup) (GBBPlus)

runners.name: Sarangpur
runners.spotlight: Fast-improving 4yo who needed only to be pushed out to win four-runner contest at Newbury (1m4f, good to firm) a fortnight ago and is now 3-4 for current stable (including a C&D win); makes obvious appeal.
runners.comment: Fast-improving 4yo who is 3-4 for current stable and makes obvious appeal

runners.name: Bohemian Breeze
runners.spotlight: Revitalised 6yo who is on a hat-trick after two 1m2f course wins in June (good/good to firm); moves up from Class 6 today but this longer trip is probably in his favour and he remains well handicapped on older form.
runners.comment: Revitalised 6yo who is on a hat-trick after two 1m2f course wins in June; 1m4f also suits

runners.name: Brave Hunter
runners.spotlight: 0-7 but went close in Newmarket handicap (1m4f, good; form well advertised by winner since) in June and was not discredited in good-quality novice race last month (first-time cheekpieces); can feature here if responding well to first-time visor.
runners.comment: Went close in Newmarket handicap in June, and not discredited in good novice since

runners.name: Tai Hang Pegasus
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden; second of five in tactical race at Epsom last month and didn't run badly when third of five at Doncaster (also 1m4f, good to firm) nine days later, despite racing too freely, but others in this line-up have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Eight-race maiden; both runs in July were respectable but others in this field appeal more

runners.name: Nibras Gold
runners.spotlight: Versatile 8yo who ran well in two chases this spring and returned to the Flat with game win from the front at Chester (1m4f, good) last month; nudged up only 1lb for that and can make another bold bid here.
runners.comment: Game winner from the front when back on the Flat last month; nudged up only 1lb for that

runners.name: Maasai Mara
runners.spotlight: Ran big race in defeat over C&D (good to firm) in May and is still well handicapped but ought to have been suited by the soft ground when soundly beaten at Goodwood (1m6f) in June and has become far too inconsistent to rely upon.
runners.comment: Good claims if judged on C&D second in May but far too inconsistent to rely upon
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late K W Bell

races.race_name: JenningsBet Top Staff Classified Stakes

runners.name: Foinix
runners.spotlight: Won this race in 2024 and collected another fast-ground C&D win last summer; nearly 6l behind Gearing's Point when keeping-on third in similar race to this here in June but still features prominently in calculations.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner; held by Gearing's Point in June C&D form but still respected
runners.owner: M Robinson, Jack Pook & Jeanette May

runners.name: Gearing's Point
runners.spotlight: Returned to form with emphatic C&D (good to firm) win in this grade in June and was not discredited under a penalty in Epsom handicap (1m4f, good) soon afterwards but needs to bounce back quickly from a 25l defeat at Lingfield on Tuesday.
runners.comment: Emphatic C&D winner in this grade in June but ran poorly at Lingfield on Tuesday

runners.name: Lady Lauren
runners.spotlight: 12-race maiden; fairly consistent in nurseries last summer (7f-1m) but has struggled to make an impact off her basement handicap mark this year (four runs; 1m-1m4f).
runners.comment: Struggling to make an impact off her basement handicap mark this year

runners.name: Dream Of Ithaca
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden; shaped quite well when fifth of 14 in Windsor handicap (11.4f, good to firm) in May and may not have been suited by the good to soft ground when well held there in June; worth a second look.
runners.comment: 0-7 but ran quite well in Windsor handicap in May; worth a second look

runners.name: Alex The Great
runners.spotlight: Three-time AW winner but not since March 2025, and his record on turf is poor; last off four in Lingfield handicap (1m6f, good to firm) 12 days ago and not the percentage call here.
runners.comment: Three-time AW winner but not since March 2025, and his record on turf is poor

runners.name: Dogged
runners.spotlight: Gave short-odds favourite a fright when second of four here (1m2f, good to firm; first-time blinkers) in June but was soundly beaten on his other four starts for Tony Carroll this year and his latest win was in 2023.
runners.comment: Went close in small field here in June but soundly beaten on other four starts this year

races.race_name: JenningsBet In Brighton Handicap

runners.name: Silver Trumpet
runners.spotlight: Bounced back from below-par run with narrow win at Epsom (7f, good to firm) last month and remains well treated after subsequent 2lb nudge; high on the list.
runners.comment: Still on good mark after 2lb nudge for last month's Epsom win; high on the list

runners.name: Serenity Dream
runners.spotlight: Fairly reliable 5yo who kept on well for narrow success at Chepstow (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; subsequent 2lb rise is manageable and this longer trip also suits; probably won't be far away.
runners.comment: 2lb rise for last month's narrow 6f win is manageable; 7f also suits; in the mix again

runners.name: Dion Baker
runners.spotlight: Resurgent front-runner who has collected five wins (three over C&D) this year; on fairly tough mark now and was soundly beaten at Newmarket on Friday but is sure to be suited by the return to this track.
runners.comment: Resurgent front-runner who has has won five times (three times over C&D) this year

runners.name: Just Jump
runners.spotlight: Quirky 4yo who often starts slowly and/or races too freely, and refused to race four outings ago; did well to win at Windsor (5f, good to firm) in June and finished well for third at Lingfield (6f, AW) on Tuesday but always comes with risk attached.
runners.comment: Finished well for third on AW on Tuesday but this quirky 4yo always comes with risk

runners.name: State Of Madness
runners.spotlight: Dual 6f course winner for Charlie Clover in October; 0-6 for current stable since April but posted sound effort when second of five over C&D (good to firm) in June and is another 1lb lower today.
runners.comment: 0-6 for current stable but was second over C&D in June and is another 1lb lower today
runners.owner: The Likely Lads & S & A Mares

runners.name: Dontspoilasale
runners.spotlight: Always behind on last month's stable debut (5f) but wasn't beaten far when sixth of eight at Windsor (6f, good to firm) a fortnight later; needs to make further progress here but should be fine over this trip and is attractively weighted on best Irish form; market reference recommended.
runners.comment: Always behind on last month's stable debut but next run was better; watch the betting

runners.name: North View
runners.spotlight: Generally disappointing since returned to turf in May but seemed to respond well to first-time visor when close second off reduced mark at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; big player if in similar form here.
runners.comment: Close second in first-time visor at Yarmouth last month; big player if in same form again

races.race_name: Knight Frank East Anglia Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Stormy Music
runners.spotlight: Four-race maiden who has shown steady improvement, close third in 7f handicap on the turf course at Lingfield most recently; may take another step forward, provided she stays this new trip; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Has shown steady improvement, close third at Lingfield most recently; in the mix

runners.name: Panelli
runners.spotlight: Record is only 1-15; however, gained the success the last time he wore headgear (cheekpieces on final start for previous yard); fairly consistent this year; interesting in first-time visor.
runners.comment: Gained sole success the last time he wore headgear; interesting in first-time visor

runners.name: Dashing Dick
runners.spotlight: Normally races over 6f/7f but has form at 1m; usually runs in Class 4; gained last three wins at the Newmarket tracks; inconsistent in 2026 but this represents a drop back in grade, off an attractive mark to boot.
runners.comment: Suited by Newmarket; inconsistent in 2026 but this represents a drop back in class

runners.name: Just Typical
runners.spotlight: Ran respectably, albeit without being able to justify favouritism, at Chepstow latest start and is back on last winning mark; however, he's a quirky sort who comes with some risk; steps back up in class.
runners.comment: Back on last winning mark but he's a quirky sort who comes with risk

runners.name: Home Hero
runners.spotlight: Rallied well in first-time visor dropped back to 1m at Sandown (good to firm) last week, opening his account at the seventh attempt; incurs 6lb penalty but Toby Moore takes off 7lb; may build on that win and improve further; respected in the retained headgear.
runners.comment: Rallied well in first-time visor at Sandown last week; may build on that win; respected

runners.name: Decalogue
runners.spotlight: Four-race maiden who showed some improvement with 40-1 fourth of six at Sandown (7f; turf/handicap debut) most recently; chance of winning depends on whether he can build on that effort.
runners.comment: Showed some improvement with fourth of six at Sandown (turf/handicap debut) last time

runners.name: Born A Rebel
runners.spotlight: Exposed mare who is often slowly away; however, her form at the Newmarket July course features a success (over 7f) last summer and close third (over 1m) last week; may remain competitive.
runners.comment: Exposed but her form at this course features a win last summer and close third last week

races.race_name: Knight Frank Suffolk Heritage Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Lord Ragnar
runners.spotlight: Good second at Lingfield (nursery debut) last time when bidding for a 7f AW double; likely to be suited by 1m and may be capable of better still; solid-looking claims back on turf.
runners.comment: Ran well last time when bidding for AW double; may be capable of better still
runners.owner: Sarah Fern, Patricia James And Partner

runners.name: High Calibre
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced colt who has been steadily getting the hang of things, midfield at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) most recently; may take a bigger step forward now handicapping; possibilities.
runners.comment: Has been steadily getting the hang of things; possibilities on handicap debut

runners.name: Peggy's Lad
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced colt who isn't entirely solid returned to turf; chance depends on whether the much improved form of his 40-1 success in Newcastle maiden (7f; AW debut) is backed up.
runners.comment: Chance depends on whether the form of his 40-1 success on AW is backed up

runners.name: Woodhay Wayfarer
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced filly who has been improving gradually, running-on fifth under 5lb claimer at Epsom (7f) most recently; could blossom in nurseries; interesting with fully-fledged rider back on board.
runners.comment: Could blossom in nurseries; interesting with fully-fledged rider back on board

runners.name: Emerald Bay
runners.spotlight: Two from two since switched to nurseries, sent beyond sprint trips and wearing cheekpieces; raised 8lb for Leicester win (7f, good to firm) last time but may improve further; respected.
runners.comment: 2-2 since switched to nurseries; raised 8lb for latest win but may improve further

races.race_name: Knight Frank Woodbridge EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Fast Performer
runners.spotlight: £58,000 yearling; promising second, behind subsequent nursery scorer, in 6f maiden at Nottingham (good to firm) where he was the sole newcomer in a field of five; sets the form standard.
runners.comment: Promising second, behind subsequent nursery scorer, at Nottingham; sets the standard

runners.name: Scienza
runners.spotlight: £40,000 yearling; Bated Breath half-brother to 7f winner Jungle Knight (RPR 62); dam once-raced daughter of useful 7f 2yo scorer; caution is advised with 7lb claimer booked on debut.
runners.comment: £40,000 yearling; by Bated Breath; caution is advised with 7lb claimer booked on debut

runners.name: Kaboom
runners.spotlight: Cotai Glory half-brother to 7f/1m winner Beyond The Bar (RPR 77), out of Group-placed 6f scorer (including 2yo; 98); Hannon newcomer who looks one of the likelier types.
runners.comment: Cotai Glory colt and Hannon newcomer who looks one of the likelier types

runners.name: Water Angel
runners.spotlight: 10,000gns foal, 16,000gns yearling; Harry Angel half-brother to 7f-1m2f winner Storm Asset (RPR 64), out of 6f/7f scorer (including German Listed; 99); others have stronger-looking claims.
runners.comment: 16,000gns yearling; by Harry Angel; others have stronger-looking claims
runners.owner: Hold My Beer, M Broughton & T Elphick

runners.name: Crown And Two
runners.spotlight: £11,000 yearling, £37,000 (breeze-up) 2yo; by Sergei Prokofiev out of unraced half-sister to smart winners Saayerr (6f 2yo Group 2) and Ornate (prolific 5f including 2yo); Billy Loughnane is a positive booking; interesting debutant.
runners.comment: £37,000 (breeze-up) 2yo; Billy Loughnane is a positive booking; interesting debutant

runners.name: Zephyra
runners.spotlight: 48,000gns yearling; by Kingman; sibling to three winners, notably Extra Elusive (1m-1m4f including 2yo/AW/Group 3; 118) and Ajaya (5.4f/6f 2yo including Group 2; RPR 113); dam unraced; sole filly in the field; adds interest, being nicely bred.
runners.comment: 48,000gns yearling; by Kingman; sole filly in the field; adds interest, being nicely bred

runners.name: Hello You Ten
runners.spotlight: Raced on the front end en route to fading in 7f contest at Doncaster, finishing sixth of ten; may improve dropped in distance with that outing under his belt.
runners.comment: Raced on front end en route to fading over 7f at Doncaster; may improve dropped to 6f

races.race_name: Knight Frank Cambridge Connections Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Cerro Blanco
runners.spotlight: Holds a Group 1 entry and he's the clear form pick in this field, having won a maiden then finished second in Listed contest, both over 7f on the other course at Newmarket (good/good to firm) in the spring.
runners.comment: Won maiden then ran well in Listed event, both on the other course at Newmarket

runners.name: Tacticalist
runners.spotlight: 5,000gns 3yo; by Kingman and first foal of 1m2f winner (RPR 86) who is closely related to 1m Group 2 scorer Prague; sole newcomer in a race that features a useful colt.
runners.comment: 5,000gns 3yo; by Kingman; sole newcomer in a race that features a useful colt

runners.name: Nothing But Love
runners.spotlight: Both starts at Lingfield, better effort when front-running fourth over 1m on AW last time; well below the standard set by the form horse in this field.
runners.comment: Both starts at Lingfield, better effort when fourth on AW last time

runners.name: Winston's Oath
runners.spotlight: Has shown modest form in bumpers and over hurdles; tailed-off last of four in 7f novice event at Leicester last week on Flat debut.
runners.comment: Modest form in bumpers and over hurdles; achieved nothing on Flat debut

races.race_name: Knight Frank Eastern Counties Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Percy Shelley
runners.spotlight: Hasn't scored under this code since his French days in 2022 but looks interesting with usual visor removed, having gained all wins (Flat/hurdles) without headgear; yard also runs High Fibre.
runners.comment: Interesting with usual visor removed; gained all wins (Flat/hurdles) without headgear

runners.name: Imperial Sovereign
runners.spotlight: On a long losing sequence, being 0-21 since debut win; however, beat all bar a subsequent scorer last time, over 1m6f at Chester, and appears to hold a fighting chance off the same mark, which is 22lb lower than his peak one.
runners.comment: 0-21 since debut win but beat all bar a subsequent scorer last time; fighting chance

runners.name: Koala Rose
runners.spotlight: Four-race maiden who has consistent form figures; creditable second, behind thriving rival, in three-runner handicap at Newbury (1m5f) most recently; in excellent hands and may still have progress in her; the least exposed contender and receives plenty of weight all round.
runners.comment: May still have progress in her; the least exposed contender and receives weight all round

runners.name: Minhad
runners.spotlight: Dual 1m4f winner; ran creditably (clear fourth) back over 1m6f last time, while leaving the impression 2m is worth a go; possibilities, provided he takes well to first-time cheekpieces (has form in blinkers/visor).
runners.comment: Ran creditably back over 1m6f last time, while leaving the impression 2m is worth a go

runners.name: High Fibre
runners.spotlight: Form for new yard comprises a staying-on third at York (1m4f; first Flat start since 2024) and career-best success, with visor applied, in notable 2m handicap hurdle at Market Rasen; may have more to offer in the retained headgear; respected.
runners.comment: Took well to first-time visor in notable handicap hurdle latest start; respected

races.race_name: Knight Frank Handicap

runners.name: Educator
runners.spotlight: Eventually drew clear from two rivals at Yarmouth (1m6f, good to firm) last week, having taken a while to respond to Billy Loughnane's urgings; previously effective over 1m4f and, even with 4lb penalty, remains well treated on peak form.
runners.comment: Drew clear from two rivals at Yarmouth last week; still well treated on peak form

runners.name: Maith Mar Or
runners.spotlight: Has finished last in small-field handicaps this term, failing to back up her 2025 maiden form; something to prove and is best watched unless the market suggests a turnaround is likely.
runners.comment: Has failed to back up her maiden form since switched to handicaps

runners.name: Revelio
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden who is very nicely bred, being a son of Frankel and from the family of Dubawi; ran well (neck second) over 1m2f on the turf track at Lingfield on handicap debut; behind Didaar at Nottingham since but may do better still; steps up in trip.
runners.comment: Five-race maiden who is nicely bred and may do better still; good effort two starts ago

runners.name: Didaar
runners.spotlight: Ran creditably, keeping on, last time when bidding for a Nottingham double (1m2f; maiden previously); remains in form and, as his dam's side confirms, looks worth another crack at 1m4f; respected.
runners.comment: Ran creditably last time when bidding for 1m2f double; looks worth another go at 1m4f

runners.name: Seeking Charles
runners.spotlight: Quite lightly raced 5yo maiden; creditable third, one place behind Educator, at Windsor (11.5f) in sole Flat start this year; a possible danger provided that form is backed up.
runners.comment: Quite lightly raced 5yo maiden; a possible danger provided latest effort is backed up

runners.name: King's Castle
runners.spotlight: Retains plenty of ability aged nine, having finished a close second in two of his three outings this term, latest at Sandown; was still capable of winning races last summer and can't be ruled out.
runners.comment: Close second in two of his three outings this term; retains plenty of ability aged nine

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF (C & G) Maiden

runners.name: Francillon
runners.spotlight: Frankel colt made an encouraging start at Killarney when a 0.5l second and he had a subsequent maiden winner 2.75l behind; should have learned plenty that day and sets the standard.
runners.comment: Promising run on debut at Killarney, had a subsequent winner behind, the one to beat

runners.name: Eagle Eyed
runners.spotlight: St Mark's Basilica colt; half-brother to winners Attack (7f 2yo; RPR 96) and Thenandnow (6f; 87); dam 6f/1m 2yo winner (inc Group 1; 112), half-sister to 6f Listed winner Polybius, out of French 12.5f Group 2 winner; lots to like on paper and could go well on debut.
runners.comment: St Mark's Basilica colt, dam Group 1 winner, lots to like on paper, could go well
runners.owner: Flaxman Stables, Mrs Magnier, M Tabor, D Smith

runners.name: Ryano Bhino
runners.spotlight: Churchill gelding; E47,000 yearling; dam 1m winner (RPR 92), half-sister to winners Love Lockdown (6f 2yo Group 3) and Chosen Character (useful 7f-1m), out of 1m2f winner; market best guide on debut.
runners.comment: E47,000 Churchill gelding, dam 1m winner, market can guide on debut

runners.name: Drumbeat
runners.spotlight: Wootton Bassett colt was 14-1 when finishing last of six on debut at the Curragh last month, but he was only 5l behind the winner; looks almost certain to improve with Ryan Moore taking over in the plate and can't be discounted.
runners.comment: Not beaten that far on debut, open to improvement and Moore takes over now
runners.owner: Westerberg & Mrs Magnier & M Tabor & D Smith

runners.name: Sovereign Jazz
runners.spotlight: Ten Sovereigns colt; dam 1m 2yo winner (RPR 92), half-sister to 5f winner Crombay, out of unraced half-sister to Swedish 1m/1m4f Listed winner Highway; yard in form but yet to have a juvenile winner this season.
runners.comment: Ten Sovereigns colt, dam 1m 2yo winner, yard yet to have a juvenile winner this term

runners.name: Wall Street
runners.spotlight: Sea The Stars colt; 1,000,000gns foal; dam twice-raced half-sister to winners I Can Fly (1m Group 2) and Viscount Barfield (7f Listed), out of maiden half-sister to French 2,000 Guineas winner Landseer; Moore prefers stablemate, but no surprise to see this expensive purchase show up well on debut.
runners.comment: 1,000,000gns Sea The Stars colt, dam half-sister to Group 2 winner, can show up well
runners.owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor

runners.name: Activity
runners.spotlight: Gleneagles colt; E120,000 yearling; dam 1m winner (RPR 87), half-sister to winners Helvezia (7f) and Caballero (7f 2yo), is granddaughter of Listed-placed 1m winner; yard going well and can ready one, so check the market.
runners.comment: E120,000 Gleneagles gelding, dam 1m winner, yard going well, check the market

runners.name: Jesus Green
runners.spotlight: Ghaiyyath colt; 100,000gns yearling; dam French 10.5f winner, sister to useful 1m-1m2f winner Spiorad, out of 6f 2yo winning half-sister to 6f Group 3 winner Lightning Moon; yard in top form and likely type on paper; check the market.
runners.comment: 100,000gns Ghaiyyath colt, dam French 10.5f winner, likely type on paper, check market

runners.name: Pints Of Glory
runners.spotlight: 10-1 on debut at Killarney and was beaten 8.5l after missing the break; will need to improve plenty on that effort to feature here and Francillon looks yard's main hope.
runners.comment: Missed the break and beaten 8.5l on debut at Killarney, Francillon yard's main hope

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden

runners.name: Hard Promises
runners.spotlight: Encouraging debut run at Cork in May (10.5f, soft); even better on second start in 3yo race at Navan (1m2f, good) when just 1l behind the 100-rated South Island and 0.75l behind the 98-rated Summer Is Tomorrow; this shorter trip could suit; obvious chance.
runners.comment: Encouraging debut run at Cork, rock solid third on latest at Navan, obvious chance

runners.name: Let's Smash It
runners.spotlight: Belied odds of 22-1 when a neck runner-up on debut at Dundalk (1m) in December; weakened in the closing stages on first start since over 10.5f back there last month; may have needed that, and bred to act on turf, so not dismissed.
runners.comment: Fine run on AW debut in December, may have needed latest, bred to act on turf

runners.name: Nemorino
runners.spotlight: Dark Angel gelding; unsold for E190,000gns as a yearling; closely related to two winners inc Dinozzo (1m-1m1f inc 2yo/HK), half-brother to five winners inc Arrest (1m-13.3f inc 2yo/Group 3; 117) and Detain (Group-placed 7f/1m AW inc 2yo; 115); dam unraced; lots to like on paper and yard can ready one; interesting debutant.
runners.comment: Dark Angel gelding, half-brother to Group 3 winner Arrest, yard can ready one

runners.name: Ask Me Again
runners.spotlight: Slowly away and no show on debut at the Curragh (6.5f, good) but much improved at Dundalk (1m) when beaten just 3.75l into fifth of 10; weakened late that day, though, so this longer trip is a query.
runners.comment: Much better effort on latest over 1m at Dundalk, not sure this step up in trip will suit

runners.name: Handani
runners.spotlight: Proved odds of 33-1 all wrong when splitting Cape Cod (handicap winner here off 92) and last week's Goodwood Group 3 winner Enceladus on debut at Naas (1m, yielding) last October; has been gelded and now sports cheekpieces; leading form claims if fully fit for return.
runners.comment: Excellent run on debut at Naas last Oct', form is strong, gelded, cheekpieces on
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Aiteall
runners.spotlight: Wootton Bassett gelding; E400,000 yearling; dam 6f 2yo winner (RPR 96), sister to 1m Listed winner/Irish 1,000 Guineas third So Wonderful and Group-placed 7f/1m2f winner Antilles; fifth in Naas barrier trial and three of the four ahead of him have since been placed in maidens; overlooked by McMonagle but not discounted.
runners.comment: E400,000 Wootton Bassett gelding, ability in barrier trial, not discounted

runners.name: Magnum Cor
runners.spotlight: Sea The Stars colt; E130,000 yearling; half-brother to four winners inc Sonnyboyliston (1m-1m6f Flat inc Ebor/Irish St Leger, RPR 121; 2m hurdle) and Lot Of Joy (1m4f-2m Flat, 101; useful 2m-2m2f hurdle); dam 1m7f-2m Flat (78) and 2m3f/2m4f hurdle winner; plenty of appeal on paper and preferred by McMonagle.
runners.comment: E130,000 Sea The Stars colt, half brother to Sonnyboyliston, preferred by McMonagle

runners.name: Plug In Hybrid
runners.spotlight: Waldgeist gelding; E13,000 yearling; half-brother to four winners inc Lime And Lemon (1m2f; RPR 83) and Black Hawk Eagle (1m5f Flat, 83; 1m7f/2m hurdle/chase); dam unraced half-sister to Oaks winner Forever Together and two 1m Group 1 winners; worth a market check on debut with Keane up.
runners.comment: E13,000 Waldgeist gelding, dam half-sister to Oaks winner, market can guide on debut

runners.name: Michinaga
runners.spotlight: Japanese-bred gelding by Rey De Oro; 9,000gns foal; closely related to Japanese 6.5f/7f dirt winner King Oliver, half-brother to Japanese 7f dirt winner Baleo Ria; dam placed 1m2f turf in Japan, sister to Japanese 1m2f Grade 2 winner Ria Amelia; probably best watched on debut.
runners.comment: Japanese bred gelding, dam sister to Grade 2 winner, likely best watched on debut

runners.name: Mothel Abbey
runners.spotlight: Arizona gelding; dam 1m2f-1m4f winner (inc AW; RPR 72), half-sister to 1m-10.6f winner Sleepy Head, out of 1m 2yo winning half-sister to 5f 2yo Group 3 winner Morning Pride; best watched unless the market speaks.
runners.comment: Arizona gelding, dam 1m2f-1m4 winner, best watched unless the market speaks
runners.owner: John Maurice Murphy & Michael O Phelan

runners.name: Matties Point
runners.spotlight: 20-1 and beaten 16.5l on debut at Dundalk last month; major improvement required.
runners.comment: 20-1 and beaten 16.5l on debut at Dundalk, major improvement required

runners.name: Parish Team
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten on debut at Gowran (9.5f, yielding) and when 66-1 over 1m5f here in June; will get a handicap mark after this.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in both starts, will get a handicap mark after this

runners.name: The Monday Club
runners.spotlight: Has beaten just one rival home in small fields at Ballinrobe and Cork; yard in top form but he'll be of more interest when sent handicapping.
runners.comment: Modest form in both starts in small fields, of more interest when handicapping

runners.name: Nottooshabby
runners.spotlight: Failed to beat a rival on debut at Limerick last month when a 16-1 shot; may need a bit more time.
runners.comment: Failed to beat a rival on debut at Limerick, may need a bit more time

runners.name: Trovao Dourado
runners.spotlight: 28-1 and failed to land a blow in a Down Royal maiden 20 days ago; may need a bit more time and experience.
runners.comment: 28-1 and soundly beaten on debut at Down Royal, may need a bit more time

races.race_name: Bahrain Turf Club Desmond Stakes (Group 3)

runners.name: Sparan Nua
runners.spotlight: Won a Naas maiden at 25-1 on debut (1m, good) and confirmed ability when showing a good turn of foot in a slowly-run Gowran conditions race (9.5f good to yielding); stepped up to 1m4f to beat a 108-rated rival in a Group 3 race at Cork; short of room at a crucial stage in the Irish Oaks, ran on well for third; drop to 1m here is hardly orthodox, but she may have the speed to prevail.
runners.comment: Unlucky not to finish closer in the Irish Oaks, good chance of regaining winning thread

runners.name: Isaac Newton
runners.spotlight: Goodwood maiden winner on debut last August (7f, good to soft); creditable run in Group 1 at Saint-Cloud (1m2f, very soft) in October; moderate efforts first two runs this term; back on song when winning a 1m1f Listed race at Navan; doubts raised by two subsequent runs; 1 3/4l behind Cowardofthecounty in the 1m1f Meld Stakes here.
runners.comment: Listed winner over 1m1f at Navan in June, doubts raised by two subsequent runs

runners.name: Needle Match
runners.spotlight: Narrow winner of a maiden over an extended 6f (soft) on his debut at Newbury last October; reappeared in the Greenham at the same venue and emerged with credit in finishing fourth of eight, looking in need of a stronger gallop; still looked raw when running in the 2,000 Guineas, eased when beaten; interesting here if he emerges more mature after three months off.
runners.comment: Eased when beaten in the 2,000 Guineas, looked promising when fourth in the Greenham

runners.name: Tokenomics
runners.spotlight: Five handicap wins, including over 1m1f at this venue; has made the frame in two C&D Listed races this season; needs to bounce back from a Curragh failure that saw him finish last of six, with Cowardofthecounty in third.
runners.comment: In the frame in two C&D Listed races this term, has to bounce back from a Curragh failure

runners.name: Al Haarith
runners.spotlight: Smart level of form in three runs at the Curragh last year, competed against the likes of Benvenuto Cellini and Hawk Mountain, including when third of five in the Beresford Stakes; flopped on seasonal debut at Fairyhouse; enjoyed a confidence-boosting win at Limerick; riding plans are positive; hard to be sure if he is worthy of 106 official rating.
runners.comment: Earned high rating at two, flopped on seasonal debut, confidence-boosting win at Limerick

runners.name: Chicago Critic
runners.spotlight: Has made the frame several times at Group level since a C&D Listed win 15 months ago; not a betting proposition on account of his 1-17 record in stakes races.
runners.comment: Has been campaigned at a high level, often runs well but has a 1-17 record in stakes races

runners.name: Cowardofthecounty
runners.spotlight: Group 3 winner over 7f at Deauville as a 2yo; lost way last season, back to form this term; runner-up to City Of Memphis in conditions race at Gowran (7f, soft) and won conditions race at Fairyhouse (7f, good); stronger form in defeat here last time, with Isaac Newton in third.
runners.comment: Gave his best display of the season when second here last time with Isaac Newton in third

runners.name: Celtic Motif
runners.spotlight: Good maiden for this stable at two, made the frame on all four starts, notably when third in the Goffs Million and fourth (demoted from third) in a 1m fillies' Group 3 event; placed in three of her four starts for Brendan Walsh in the US; has had a confidence-boosting win against much inferior opposition at Killarney.
runners.comment: Useful at two, spell in the US, belatedly opened his account in a weak maiden at Killarney

runners.name: Audience
runners.spotlight: Front-running Lockinge winner in 2024 and Group 2 winner at Goodwood the same year; on a losing run since then and had experienced many reverses before being placed in two Irish 7f Group 3 races this term; made much of the running when second on soft ground here in June; similar scenario when third at the Curragh last month; likely to be in the mix.
runners.comment: Former Lockinge winner, placed in two Irish Group races this term, should not be far away

races.race_name: Ballyroan Stakes (Group 3)

runners.name: Ethical Diamond
runners.spotlight: Remarkable hat-trick last season in the Duke of Edinburgh Stakes at Royal Ascot, Ebor at York and Breeders' Cup Turf at Del Mar; below-par at Meydan in March when the race was not run to suit him; never landed a blow in the Hardwicke Stakes; now has some questions to answer, but this looks a fine opportunity to get back in the groove.
runners.comment: Never landed a blow in the Hardwicke Stakes, the clear pick on last year's superb form

runners.name: Gaucher
runners.spotlight: 150-rated hurdler; has done well on AW, notching two emphatic wins at Dundalk before excellent second in 1m2f Newcastle handicap on Good Friday; never threatened in Royal Ascot's Wolferton Stakes; not in the same league as stablemate Ethical Diamond.
runners.comment: Smart dual-purpose sort, best Flat form on AW, not in the same league as Ethical Diamond
runners.owner: Mrs Rose Boyd & Mrs Marie J Armstrong

runners.name: Ascending
runners.spotlight: Progressive last season, completing a hat-trick in the 2m4f Ascot Stakes; continued on the upgrade when second to Ethical Diamond in the Ebor at York (1m6f); has failed to recapture his best form in two trips to Ascot this season; was getting 6lb from the Mullins horse in the Ebor, now rated 20lb inferior.
runners.comment: Was getting 6lb when second to Ethical Diamond in the 2025 Ebor, now rated 20lb inferior

runners.name: Endorsement
runners.spotlight: Second to subsequent Derby winner Christmas Day in Group 3 Ballysax here (1m2f, good to yielding) in April and again finished close up in Group 3 Derby Trial here; long odds-on when making all in a four-runner Listed race over C&D; good second when dropped back to 1m2f at Royal Ascot; has joined Joseph O'Brien from Ballydoyle.
runners.comment: Solid form in Pattern races, C&D Listed winner, has joined Joseph O'Brien from Ballydoyle

runners.name: Asakir
runners.spotlight: Made most for a 1m2f maiden win here in April on second outing; backed that up with second to Limestone in a Listed race at Navan (1m5f, yielding); could manage only seventh of 11 behind Limestone in the Queen's Vase; still early days, open to improvement.
runners.comment: Course 1m2f maiden winner, Listed-placed over 1m5f, still early days, open to improvement
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Dallas Star
runners.spotlight: Group 3 winner over 1m2f at three; losing sequence stands at 14 since a Dundalk win early last year; flattered by his proximity to star stayer Scandinavia in a 1m6f Listed race at Navan in April; remote seventh behind Illinois in the Queen Alexandra; up against it.
runners.comment: Losing run stands at 14 since a Dundalk win early last year, sequence likely to continue

runners.name: Green Impact
runners.spotlight: Beat the top-class Delacroix in a Group 2 here as a juvenile; sixth in last season's 2,000 Guineas before making all in a 1m1f Listed race at this venue; respectable efforts in the Irish Derby (only run over 1m4f) and in a York Group 2; stamina not assured, judged on overall profile and two runs this season; well held in fourth in the Tattersalls Gold Cup.
runners.comment: Very useful form at around 1m2f, only previous 1m4f run was when sixth in 2025 Irish Derby

runners.name: Layfayette
runners.spotlight: His record now stands at 11 wins and 16 places; he celebrated his 50th outing by winning a Listed race on his favoured soft ground at Limerick in June, his seventh stakes win; would benefit most from a marked deterioration of ground conditions.
runners.comment: Won his seventh stakes race on his favoured soft ground at Limerick in June, needs rain

runners.name: Omni Man
runners.spotlight: Handicap winner over 1m4f at Glorious Goodwood last season; low-key efforts in April/May before showing signs of a return to form when fifth in a Royal Ascot handicap; inferior to his recently-acquired stablemate Endorsement.
runners.comment: Good effort when fifth in a Royal Ascot handicap, inferior to new stablemate Endorsement

races.race_name: Carnival de Leop Handicap

runners.name: Desert Of The Sea
runners.spotlight: Useful form at a modest level on AW last winter; poor recent run on turf; trainer's Jazzit is more appealing; first reserve.
runners.comment: First reserve, useful form at a modest level on AW last winter, poor recent run on turf

runners.name: Jazzit
runners.spotlight: Placed three times at sprint distances on AW earlier in the year; best turf run so far when third in a 19-runner 6f contest at Cork recently; worth another shot at this trip, now that he is more mature than at the time of previous attempts in Britain.
runners.comment: Placed three times on AW earlier in the year, best turf run so far at Cork recently

runners.name: Launch Time
runners.spotlight: Made the breakthrough in a C&D handicap in April (good); ran to a similar level at Cork later in the month when beaten 3l into fourth; followed that with a disappointing effort at this venue, with soft ground a possible excuse; solid third behind Pete's Dream at Fairyhouse on latest; 7f might be too sharp.
runners.comment: Won well over 1m here on seasonal debut, solid third on latest, 7f might be   too sharp

runners.name: Wellwhatshappenin
runners.spotlight: Had enjoyed a consistent spell at Dundalk before a poor run in March; turf form is weak, and the lack of a recent run may count against him.
runners.comment: Had enjoyed a consistent spell at Dundalk before a poor run in March, weak turf form

runners.name: Draiocht
runners.spotlight: Breakthrough win came at Killarney last October (1m, soft); made a pleasing return when fourth at the same venue last month, 2 1/4 behind subsequent winner Pete's Dream.
runners.comment: Killarney winner last autumn, made a pleasing return at the same venue last month

runners.name: The Blue Panther
runners.spotlight: Five career wins, the last two coming at Listowel; has plenty to find with Pete's Dream and Draoicht on running at Killarney; however, his recent Gowran second suggests he could go close; lack of consistency is a worry; drawn high too, but rider is capable of coping with that potential negative.
runners.comment: Recent Gowran run suggests he could go close, lack of consistency is a worry, drawn high
runners.owner: Ms Julianne McNally & Colette McNally & D McNally

runners.name: Pete's Dream
runners.spotlight: Belated first win came over an extended 1m at Fairyhouse early last month, with Launch Time in third; fair third off his revised mark in a 1m contest at Killarney, with Draiocht in fourth; concerning that he has been unplaced in four 7f attempts.
runners.comment: Has shown improved form over a bit further than this, unplaced in four 7f attempts

runners.name: Micasso
runners.spotlight: Managed a few fair runs last year and was a surprise winner on return at Bellewstown (1m, good); failed to back that up at Dundalk; not the most reliable type.
runners.comment: Long-priced winner at Bellewstown on seasonal debut, failed to back that up at Dundalk

runners.name: Gordon Bennett
runners.spotlight: Four-time turf winner; in the form of his life for Dick Brabazon in 2022, winning three times in a July-to-September spell, and rising to a career-high mark of 94; frustrating in recent seasons; joined Peter Fahey late last year after a claiming-race third on AW; has slumped to a career-low mark of 56; champion jockey up; won when fresh early in his career.
runners.comment: In the form of his life in 2022, has been frustrating, career-low mark, champion jockey up

runners.name: Dinamine
runners.spotlight: Took a long time to win a race; scored twice last season and added another in first-time cheekpieces last time, overcoming a slow start to score over 1m at Naas; reasonably effective over 7f, up 6lb and has plenty of weight here, though rider's 3lb claim will help a little.
runners.comment: Overcame a slow start to win over 1m at Naas, reasonably effective over 7f, up 6lb

runners.name: Master Garvey
runners.spotlight: Only two wins from 54 races; often placed, though only once from six Leopardstown visits; creditable third at Gowran 12 days ago gives him an each-way chance; trainer got on the scoreboard at Galway.
runners.comment: Only two wins from 54 races, often placed, creditable third at Gowran 12 days ago
runners.owner: Patrick M O'Brien & Larry Murray & Derek Cummins

runners.name: Imperial Dream
runners.spotlight: Most recent of three wins came at the Curragh nearly two years ago (6f, good-to-firm); only flashes of his best last season, out of sorts this term.
runners.comment: Best Irish form was in 2024, only flashes of his best last season, out of sorts this term

runners.name: Dress Dance
runners.spotlight: Weak form in 2025; never in contention when stepped up in trip at Cork in May; headgear on; hard to make a case for her.
runners.comment: Weak form in 2025, never in contention when stepped up in trip at Cork in May, headgear on

runners.name: Smaoineamh Sile
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner; has been badly out of form since a second placing on AW last October; first time with this headgear combination.
runners.comment: Five-time winner, has been badly out of form since a second placing on AW last October

runners.name: Brains
runners.spotlight: Veteran winner of 14 races (11 on AW); respectable form in recent months, highlighted by a Roscommon second; place chance if running up to that level.
runners.comment: Veteran winner of 14 races (11 on AW), respectable form in recent months, place chance

runners.name: Cannonball Queen
runners.spotlight: Best run was on debut, has failed to beat a single opponent in three races this term; needs a miracle in first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Best run was on debut, has failed to beat a single opponent in three races this term

runners.name: Suerte
runners.spotlight: Never closer than seventh in four handicap attempts; seems regressive; second reserve.
runners.comment: Second reserve, never closer than seventh in four handicap attempts, seems regressive

runners.name: Mogwli
runners.spotlight: Useful form last autumn featured the eighth win of his career, achieved under this rider in a 1m Bellewstown event; totally out of form this term, failing to reach the first ten in four runs between March and May.
runners.comment: Useful form last autumn featured the eighth win of his career, totally out of form now

races.race_name: Renault Ireland Handicap

runners.name: Tequila
runners.spotlight: Displayed ability but failed to win in Britain; should strip fitter for her stable debut in a maiden at Dundalk 25 days ago; not badly drawn and could go well.
runners.comment: Ability without winning in Britain, strip fitter for stable debut at Dundalk, may go well

runners.name: Stepdance
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose; completed quickfire hat-trick on the Flat last summer at around 1m4f; remains 3lb above the last of those wins and was pulled up over hurdles when last seen at Tramore in May; others appeal more.
runners.comment: Remains 3lb above last win, pulled up over hurdles at Tramore latest, others preferred

runners.name: Sinbad My Dad
runners.spotlight: Won this off 4lb lower last season; ran on well for a close fourth here on latest over 1m2f; not the kindest of draws, but should be staying on at the finish.
runners.comment: Won this off 4lb lower last year, decent run over 1m2f here on latest, drawn wide
runners.owner: Mrs Helen Butler & John A Griffin & Mrs Bernadette Fahey

runners.name: Bella Colombia
runners.spotlight: Consistent mare gained the third win of her career (and first on turf) at Killarney last month (1m, good); up 7lb and moves up in grade but nicely drawn here and can't be dismissed in her current form.
runners.comment: Up 7lb and in grade after Killarney win, nicely drawn and can't be dismissed

runners.name: Tachos
runners.spotlight: Has now slipped to 2lb below her last winning mark (which came over C&D) and her last run here over 1m was a step in the right direction; tough draw to overcome but not discounted.
runners.comment: 2lb below last year's C&D win, step in right direction on latest, drawn very wide

runners.name: Nibras Rainbow
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; in fine fettle this season; has won two of last five starts, including over C&D on penultimate off 4lb lower; another solid third at Ballinrobe on latest and should go well again if gets a run here.
runners.comment: Won two of last five inc' over C&D, another decent run latest, go well if gets in; reserve

runners.name: Comfort Line
runners.spotlight: A winner of ten races on AW and turf at 7f-1m; hasn't won on grass since August 2022 but did go close over 1m here in April off 4lb lower; has never won over this far a trip.
runners.comment: No win on turf since August 2022, ran well over 1m here in April, this trip is a concern

runners.name: Darkdeserthighway
runners.spotlight: Four-time AW winner; sole success on turf came in 2021; ran on well over 7f at Naas latest, beaten just 2l; step up in trip a plus on that evidence and runs off the same mark; place chance.
runners.comment: Stayed on over 7f at Naas on latest, steps up in trip, runs off same mark, place chance

runners.name: Tanzanite Diamond
runners.spotlight: 3yo showed minor promise in maidens; far from disgraced on handicap debut at the Curragh (1m2f, gd-fm), beaten 4.5l in much better race than this; eased 2lb and could go well dropped back slightly in trip.
runners.comment: Far from disgraced on handicap bow latest, eased 2lb, drops in trip, this is easier

runners.name: Pallatine Hills
runners.spotlight: 0-12 but has shown enough to suggest he can win races; should step forward from latest run after a break here over 1m, but hasn't got the kindest of draws.
runners.comment: 0-12, has ability, should come on for latest run here over 1m, not the kindest of draws

runners.name: Star Mind
runners.spotlight: Bolted up over C&D (yld-sft) in April off 8lb lower; burst blood vessel on her next start over 1m2f here in May and off since; comes with risks attached now.
runners.comment: Bolted up over C&D in April off 8lb lower, burst blood vessel latest, risks attached

runners.name: Cleopatra's Needle
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; dual-purpose; last two wins have come over hurdles; respectable run in that sphere at Galway last week; remains 3lb above sole Flat win but ran a cracker over 1m here in April, so not discounted.
runners.comment: Okay run over hurdles at Galway, went close over 1m here in April, not dismissed; reserve

runners.name: The Holy Apostle
runners.spotlight: First reserve; 0-10 and hasn't built on promising handicap debut third at Killarney last August; latest run at Naas a bit better but still beaten over 10l; others appeal more.
runners.comment: 0-10, latest run not his worst but still beaten over 10l, others appeal more; reserve

runners.name: Moyassr
runners.spotlight: Solid strike rate on AW (4-10) but just 1-17 on turf; that win came at Fairyhouse (1m2f, good) in May off 5lb lower; has struggled off revised mark in three runs since and handicapper slow to relent.
runners.comment: Has struggled since 1m2f win at Fairyhouse in May, handicapper slow to relent

runners.name: Jasmine Affanalis
runners.spotlight: Sole win came over this trip at Tipperary last season off 5lb lower; not the clearest of runs when 1.5l behind Bella Colombia at Killarney latest; nudged up 2lb and wide draw not ideal, but weighted to reverse that Killarney form and enters calculations.
runners.comment: Denied clear run when behind Bella Colombia latest, drawn wide but enters calculations

runners.name: Sonic Invader
runners.spotlight: Maiden's best runs this term have come over 1m6f at Gowran and 2m at Listowel; weakened over 14.5f at Killarney on latest; worth a go at this sort of trip but needs more.
runners.comment: Maiden, best form this term over 1m6f-2m, worth a  go at this trip but more needed

runners.name: Wild Berries
runners.spotlight: Didn't show a whole lot in maidens last year and similar story so far in handicaps; beaten 7.25l when seventh of 11 at Dundalk (7f) on latest; not an obvious candidate for this longer trip on breeding.
runners.comment: Hasn't shown much in first three handicaps, beaten over 7l on latest, this trip a query

runners.name: Guy's Girl
runners.spotlight: Maiden is 0-7 on turf; not a bad run when 4l third at Ballinrobe (1m5f, yielding) on penultimate, but failed to back it up at Tramore last time; drops markedly in trip now; risky.
runners.comment: 0-7 on turf, tame effort on latest at Tramore, big drop in trip here, risky

runners.name: Werifesteria
runners.spotlight: Ordinary form in maidens at around 1m4f on good ground and on the AW; bred to do better at some stage and makes handicap debut with yard in form, so check the market.
runners.comment: Modest maiden form, makes h'cap debut with yard going well, check the market

runners.name: Quafftide
runners.spotlight: Handicap debutante has shown ability in maidens on soft ground, including here over 7f; only beaten 4l when fourth at Limerick on latest (7f, soft); nice draw and should stay this far on breeding; tongue-tie goes on.
runners.comment: Handicap debutante, ability in 7f maidens inc' here, tongue tie on, should stay this far

runners.name: Ohmali
runners.spotlight: Best run this term came over 1m here in May, staying on from the back for a 3l second; 1lb lower now but has to bounce back from two below-par efforts at Limerick and Naas.
runners.comment: Encouraging run here in May, 1lb lower now, below best last twice, needs to rebound

runners.name: Dancing Steve
runners.spotlight: Has winning form at this trip and is 6lb lower than when winning at Navan (1m2f, good) just over a year ago; however, badly out of sorts in three runs this term and not easy to fancy on recent form.
runners.comment: Is 6lb below last win but form this year poor, hard to fancy on recent showings

runners.name: Ardeur
runners.spotlight: Yet to add to 2yo success for Ralph Beckett; heavy defeats all three starts this year; mark tumbling but she needs a revival.
runners.comment: Heavy defeats all three starts this term, mark tumbling but she needs to revive

runners.name: Little Wing
runners.spotlight: Down the field in three maidens at 6f-1m; could improve for switch to handicaps and worth a market check.
runners.comment: Modest maiden efforts at 6f-1m, potential improver in first h'cap, check the market

races.race_name: Fegentri World Championship (Q.R.) Handicap

runners.name: Chutzpal
runners.spotlight: Capable dual-purpose performer won a nice pot on the Flat at Killarney last August off 4lb lower; stepped forward from below-par seasonal return when a 4.75l fifth at Fairyhouse on latest (3l behind Not Just Any Eagle); eased 2lb and place chance.
runners.comment: Stepped forward from below-par return when fifth at Fairyhouse, eased 2lb, place chance

runners.name: He Who Dares
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose sort has got the hang of things in recent starts; won over hurdles at Wexford and backed that up with a close third on the Flat at Tramore (2m, good); place claims at the very least again off the same mark.
runners.comment: Won over hurdles at Wexford, close third on the Flat latest, same mark here, chance

runners.name: Boxing Great
runners.spotlight: 2m AW winner has run well in defeat at times on turf; not disgraced in the Northumberland Vase at Newcastle on latest when beaten 4.25l; more needed back on the grass.
runners.comment: 2m AW winner, not beaten that far at Newcastle latest, needs more back on turf

runners.name: Derry Lad
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner on long losing run; shaped okay when fifth at Naas on penultimate, but didn't build on that when beaten 7l over 1m5f here on latest; needs more upped in trip.
runners.comment: On long losing run, ok run at Naas on penultimate, below par here latest, needs more

runners.name: Miss Gitana
runners.spotlight: Bounced back to form with a close third under a positive ride over C&D two weeks ago; nudged up 1lb but remains 2lb below her last win and yard had a nice winner at Galway last week; in the mix.
runners.comment: Back to form over C&D latest, up 1lb but remains 2lb below last win, in the mix

runners.name: Makaiah
runners.spotlight: Best on good ground and shaped nicely on seasonal return over 1m4f (good) at Roscommon when a 2.5l second; failed to fire at Ballinrobe on latest but didn't get her ground; could rebound on this more suitable surface.
runners.comment: Best on good ground, didn't get favoured conditions on latest, could rebound now

runners.name: Peace Walk
runners.spotlight: Won a soft-ground novice for Charlie Johnston in September 2023 but has come up dry since; back from mammoth layoff with moderate run in a Limerick claimer on debut for this yard in June; may need another run or two to hit top form.
runners.comment: Back from mammoth layoff with modest run in Limerick claimer, others preferred

runners.name: Catalani
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point and hunter chase winner; modest form in three Flat maidens including over C&D; not obviously well treated for this handicap debut and probably best watched for now.
runners.comment: Modest form in three Flat maidens including over C&D, not obviously well treated, watch

runners.name: Not Just Any Eagle
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner, most recently here over 1m4f in May 2025; 2lb lower here and shaped like coming back to form when a 1.75l third at Fairyhouse (1m6f) on latest; stays this trip and enters calculations now.
runners.comment: Course winner over 1m4f, 2lb lower now and back to form on latest, big player

runners.name: Supreme Law
runners.spotlight: Long-standing maiden tailed off in first two runs for this yard last summer and hasn't been seen since; miles out of the handicap here and impossible to make a case for.
runners.comment: Tailed off in two runs last summer, off since, impossible to make a case for, 13lb wrong

races.race_name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div I)

runners.name: Distillation
runners.spotlight: Posted an improved effort when holding on to win by a head at Wolverhampton (7f, AW; made all) 16 days ago, getting off the mark at the sixth attempt; this extra furlong is a slight concern but he has claims if seeing it out; only 3lb higher.
runners.comment: Made all when off the mark over 7f at Wolverhampton latest; big player if staying 1m

runners.name: Athenian Spirit
runners.spotlight: 12-race maiden but he did finish runner-up on the AW three times for his previous stable (all in cheekpieces which are off today); missed the break and never featured in race won by Distillation at Wolverhampton (7f) 16 days ago; possibilities back up in trip.
runners.comment: Runner-up three times for previous yard; never featured after missing the break latest

runners.name: Mist Of Time
runners.spotlight: Respectable fourth of seven in a classified event at Yarmouth (1m2f, good to firm) in June but she didn't build on that at Brighton (1m2f) last month; drops back to 1m and returns to handicap company; others stronger.
runners.comment: Respectable fourth at Yarmouth (1m2f) in June but failed to build on that at Brighton

runners.name: Hear The Drums
runners.spotlight: Won off this mark at Leicester (7f, soft) last October and was subsequently gelded; well beaten in three starts this year and on his only previous try on the AW; others preferred.
runners.comment: Won on soft ground at Leicester last October; well beaten in three starts this year

runners.name: Soda
runners.spotlight: Posted an RPR of 54 on her debut at Catterick (7f, good) in April but she's not built on that in four starts since, including two handicaps (1m/6f); steps back up in trip with a bit to prove on her AW debut.
runners.comment: Yet to build on her debut outing in four starts since; bit to prove on her AW debut

runners.name: Singarda
runners.spotlight: Ten-race maiden; didn't run badly when fifth of seven at Beverley (8.5f, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) two starts back but he was well held at Ripon 19 days ago; dropped another 2lb and not dismissed at this level.
runners.comment: 0-10; didn't run badly at Beverley but well held at Ripon last time; down another 2lb
runners.owner: D Bishop, S Bland & T Coyle

runners.name: Miss Mambo
runners.spotlight: Well held on her first two handicaps (1m/1m4f) and she faded into sixth having controlled the pace in a maiden at Wolverhampton (9.5f, AW; first-time blinkers) 39 days ago; returns to handicap company and others are preferred.
runners.comment: Well held in two handicaps and faded into sixth in a Wolverhampton maiden last time (9.5f)

runners.name: Go Teejay
runners.spotlight: Beaten about 2l when sixth of nine on his handicap debut at Doncaster (7f, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) but he's been well beaten in both starts since; steps up to 1m with much better needed.
runners.comment: Beaten about 2l on his handicap debut but well beaten in both starts since; up to 1m

runners.name: Retro Rocket
runners.spotlight: Huge prices and has struggled in each of his three starts (6f-8.5f; AW/good to firm); big step forward needed on his handicap debut.
runners.comment: Huge prices and has struggled in each of his three starts; big step forward needed

runners.name: Lady Fizz
runners.spotlight: Tailed off on her debut at Newmarket (1m, good; hooded) in April when trained by Des Donovan and she was well beaten in two starts on the AW over 7f last month; steps back up in trip on handicap debut with better needed.
runners.comment: Tailed off on her debut over 1m and well beaten in two starts on the AW; handicap debut

races.race_name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div II)

runners.name: Elashgar
runners.spotlight: Best form when scoring over 6f on AW in February and third over 7f on turf last time; judged solely on breeding, has a stamina doubt upped to 1m.
runners.comment: Judged solely on breeding, has a stamina doubt upped to 1m

runners.name: Alice's Influence
runners.spotlight: Showed improved form when a visor was first fitted; no further progress kept to turf since but today's change of headgear may have positive effect.
runners.comment: Record suggests today's change of headgear may have positive effect

runners.name: Here Comes Louie
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden who went very close despite major traffic issues in 1m classified event at Thirsk most recently, looking desperately unlucky; respected assuming that improved form is backed up.
runners.comment: Desperately unlucky in Thirsk classified event last time; respected

runners.name: Starakova
runners.spotlight: Building up a better record on AW than on turf and ran creditably at Wolverhampton (the scene of her sole win) most recently; may still have more to offer in this sphere.
runners.comment: Building up a better record on AW than on turf; may still have more to offer

runners.name: Gloriola
runners.spotlight: Failed to make the frame in turf races; placed in a couple of 8.5f classified contests at Wolverhampton since switched to AW, splitting subsequent winners on the first occasion; solid-looking claims.
runners.comment: Placed in two classified contests at Wolverhampton since switched to AW

runners.name: Speckled Brown
runners.spotlight: Four-race maiden who has weak claims on form; drops back in trip for this second handicap attempt.
runners.comment: Weak claims on form

runners.name: Ernie McCrew
runners.spotlight: Has shaped quite encouragingly from off the pace in last two starts but needs improvement to get off the mark and also perhaps requires the cards to drop right.
runners.comment: Has shaped quite encouragingly the last twice but needs to find improvement

runners.name: Gilleangirl
runners.spotlight: Far from solid on her 7f novice efforts but may do better now handicapping, upped in trip and fitted with tongue-tie; check the market signals for further guidance.
runners.comment: May do better now handicapping, upped in trip and fitted with tongue-tie

runners.name: Thomas Tallis
runners.spotlight: Showed signs of improvement in Wolverhampton classified race in sole outing this year but needs to build on that effort.
runners.comment: Needs to build on sole effort this term

races.race_name: Simon Davis Big 60th Birthday Bash Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Kiss Me My Love
runners.spotlight: Has a patchy profile but she's won twice on turf this season including an apprentice handicap at Redcar (1m, good to firm) last Wednesday; 0-7 on AW but she has form over C&D and is a big player off the same mark as last time (due to be 2lb higher in future).
runners.comment: Escapes a penalty for her win at Redcar and she's a big player back on AW

runners.name: Court Of Stars
runners.spotlight: Won a Kempton handicap (7f, AW) in May but she's been well held at Wolverhampton (9.4f/7f) in her last two starts; now only 1lb higher than for her win but overall record is 1-10 and she needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: On workable mark but she struggled on Tapeta last time and needs to get back on track

runners.name: Dream Illusion
runners.spotlight: All four wins have been on AW and last two were over C&D in the spring; remains feasibly treated off only 1lb higher than for her last success and she's run well on turf in last two starts including a near-miss at Wetherby (7f, good to firm); usually comes from off the pace and she's strongly respected back up in trip.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner who has been in good form on turf recently; respected back up in trip

runners.name: Filly Eilish
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the fifth attempt when beating 12 rivals in a C&D handicap (16-1) ten days ago; has a penalty but she beat a clear second last time and is open to more progress; interesting contender.
runners.comment: Off the mark at the fifth attempt when landing a C&D handicap; respected under penalty

runners.name: Blue Celestial
runners.spotlight: 0-11 but she made a bold bid when a close second in a Wolverhampton handicap (8.6f, Tapeta) two weeks ago; back up 4lb in the weights but she was clear of the third last time and that was a personal best; shortlisted.
runners.comment: 0-11 but she made a bold bid when a clear second at Wolverhampton latest; shortlisted

runners.name: Kartini
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who signed off for Oliver Cole with good second in a Chelmsford handicap (1m2f, AW) in November; on same mark here but she struggled on her stable debut at Pontefract (1m, good to firm) last month and needs to bounce back after that heavy defeat.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 4yo but she was tailed off on recent stable debut at Pontefract (1m)

runners.name: Hauteluce
runners.spotlight: Made it second-time lucky when landing a Wolverhampton maiden (9.4f, AW) in June; well-held third when odds-on at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm) last time but she took a strong hold in that tactical race and it's still early days for this well-bred filly; could resume her progress now switched to a handicap and she needs a close look on this drop back in trip.
runners.comment: Unexposed filly who won at Wolverhampton in June; needs a close look on handicap debut

runners.name: Zarinca
runners.spotlight: Reappeared with a win in a maiden here (6f) in April but she's been well held in three handicaps since; still has low mileage but she needs to find more at this new trip.
runners.comment: Won a maiden here (6f) in April but she's been well held in three handicaps since

runners.name: Ravishing Beauty
runners.spotlight: Triple turf winner who scored at Carlisle (1m, soft) in June and has finished a respectable third at Pontefract in her last two starts; still unexposed on AW and she should be in the mix again back in this sphere.
runners.comment: Won at Carlisle in June and she's run well at Pontefract last twice; in the mix back on AW

runners.name: Gifts Differing
runners.spotlight: Beaten 7l or more in five runs for James Ferguson including two handicaps (1m2f/1m); still early days but she needs a transformation back on AW for new yard; cheekpieces worn last time are removed.
runners.comment: Well held in five runs for James Ferguson and she needs a transformation for new yard

runners.name: Zermatt Star
runners.spotlight: No progress in four runs for Jessica Harrington and was only fourth of five on her stable debut at Hamilton (8.3f, good to firm) last month; dropped another 2lb but she needs to raise her game on this switch to AW.
runners.comment: Five-race maiden and she needs to raise her game on this switch to AW

races.race_name: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (B/C/D) (EBF Qual') (GBB/GBBPlus)

runners.name: Quest For Glory
runners.spotlight: Inexperience evident when fourth on debut at Kempton (7f, Polytrack) in June and he built on that with close third at Lingfield (7f, Polytrack) last month; he's bred to appreciate today's extra yardage; in the mix.
runners.comment: Close 3rd over 7f at Lingfield on second start & bred to appreciate today's extra yardage

runners.name: Vinery
runners.spotlight: Left his debut run (7f, good) well behind when beaten a neck in a seller at Leicester (6f, good to firm) last month, keeping on well after being outpaced; has since left David Evans and the Leicester form has been franked by the third; the step up to 1m is worth a go and he's respected on stable debut.
runners.comment: Strong finish for close second in 6f seller at Leicester; respected on stable debut

runners.name: Baarberini
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to a 1m2f French winner who made good late headway when third at 16-1 on debut at Kempton (7f, Polytrack) in June; today's extra furlong looks a firm plus and there's plenty to like.
runners.comment: Good late headway when third over 7f on debut at Kempton; plenty to like

runners.name: Bullrider
runners.spotlight: 1l second on debut at Epsom (7f, good) last month and similar form when 2l third here (7f) ten days ago; there's every chance that he will stay 1m and he's one to consider.
runners.comment: Placed last month on first two starts (including here) and he's one to consider

runners.name: Phantom Knight
runners.spotlight: 43,000euros yearling; third foal; Japan half-brother to German winners Princess (6.5f 2yo) and Prolet (1m1f); dam German 7.5f 2yo winner, half-sister to smart 1m1f-1m4f winner Paradias; with a highly respected stable and could give a good account on debut.
runners.comment: Half-brother to two German winners; with a highly respected stable; could go well on debut

runners.name: Kodiac City
runners.spotlight: £50,000 2yo breeze-ups; second foal; dam unraced half-sister to 6f 2yo winner Lady Kodiac (by Kodiac), out of German 1m1f Listed winning close relative of 1m Group 1 winner Zafeen; trainer does well with 2yos on AW and the betting could be informative regarding this Kodiac newcomer.
runners.comment: £50,000 2yo breeze-ups; trainer does well with 2yos on AW; betting could guide on debut

runners.name: Astral Crown
runners.spotlight: Raced in last throughout when soundly beaten at 11-2 on last month's debut at Ayr (7f, good to firm); however, he has a useful pedigree and is a possible improver on this second start; watch the betting.
runners.comment: Raced in last throughout on last month's debut at Ayr but he has a useful pedigree

runners.name: Hoosthat
runners.spotlight: Reared and unseated rider before the start on his debut at Leicester (7f, good; 18-1) in June, when he was green and soon detached; probably best watched for now.
runners.comment: Inexperience evident when tailed off on debut at Leicester and he's best watched for now

races.race_name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap (Div I)

runners.name: Moostar
runners.spotlight: Record since the tongue-tie went on in December reads 2323223628; possible to forgive her latest effort at Wolverhampton (7f, Tapeta), but others are preferred for the win even so; hood removed after one use.
runners.comment: Record since tongue-tie went on in December reads 2323223628; others preferred for the win

runners.name: Daytona Lady
runners.spotlight: Seven wins on the AW including two over C&D, but she needs a strong pace to run at and some luck, which she didn't get at Wolverhampton (6f, Tapeta) last month; not certain this will be run to suit either, but she has the ability to figure if it is.
runners.comment: Seven wins on the AW including two over C&D, but she needs a strong pace to run at
runners.owner: Eric Broadwith And Mrs Ruth Carr

runners.name: Ziggy's Condor
runners.spotlight: Handy sort; one of his three wins came over C&D early last year and he has become well handicapped, while he ran his best race since joining Adam Kirby when third of eight at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) on Saturday; should be bang there with a repeat; visor returns.
runners.comment: C&D winner; favourably handicapped and ran well when third at Doncaster last time

runners.name: Pickersgill
runners.spotlight: Record around here reads 122, beaten just half a length under a positive ride over C&D ten days ago; has the outside stall, but still a major player from the same mark (1lb well in).
runners.comment: Record here reads 122; has the outside stall, but still a major player (1lb well in)

runners.name: Court Drive
runners.spotlight: Made the most of a reduced mark when regaining winning form at Yarmouth (6f, soft) in June and possible to make excuses for her two subsequent defeats; capable of playing a part in the returning blinkers if they go a good pace.
runners.comment: Won at Yarmouth in June and possible to forgive her two efforts since; blinkers return

runners.name: Cairdeas
runners.spotlight: Failed to beat a rival over C&D ten days ago (Pickersgill second); drops in grade, but still enough doubts remain.
runners.comment: Failed to beat a rival over C&D ten days ago; drops in grade, but enough doubts remain

runners.name: Ottawa
runners.spotlight: Made it tenth-time lucky when scoring over C&D for Joseph Parr in December, but held in all three starts since; makes his stable debut after six months off having changed hands for 4,400gns in February; watch market.
runners.comment: C&D winner; makes his stable debut after six months off; watch market

runners.name: Showtime Mahomes
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D winner, the latest off this mark in January; returns from 163 days off minus any headgear, but can go well fresh; possible player.
runners.comment: Back off same mark as when winning over C&D in January; can go well fresh; possible player

runners.name: Miraculous
runners.spotlight: Placed just once in eight starts since returning for this yard in April, but has been contesting much warmer handicaps than this on turf; won on Tapeta for previous yard and worth a second look down at this level.
runners.comment: Has been contesting much warmer handicaps on turf; won on Tapeta for previous yard

runners.name: Hectic
runners.spotlight: C&D winner in October 2024 and 5lb lower than when last successful, but hasn't lately shaped like a winner waiting to happen (underwent wind surgery before penultimate outing); stable also runs Ottawa.
runners.comment: C&D winner in October 2024 and 5lb lower than when last successful, but held of late

races.race_name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap (Div II)

runners.name: Spirit Of Jenny
runners.spotlight: Off the mark over C&D in April on her eighth start and creditable second at Leicester (6f, good to firm) next time; this lightly raced 4yo can be bang there if returning from a break in the same good form.
runners.comment: Off the mark over C&D in April and good second since; could be bang there

runners.name: Sarafina Mshairi
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on both runs this year (5f), here most recently, and a major turnaround is necessary; however, the form of the stable catches the eye and she won over C&D last October; back up in trip today; interesting.
