runners.comment: Well beaten on both runs this year but stable form catches the eye and she's a C&D winner

runners.name: Jesse Luc
runners.spotlight: Beaten on his last 12 starts and only sixth at Wolverhampton last month, but he was returning from a break and was slowly away; could be sharper for that latest outing and he ran well in third over C&D in April; this three-time C&D winner is capable of having a big say.
runners.comment: Could be sharper for latest outing; this 3-time C&D winner is capable of having a big say

runners.name: Fan Mail
runners.spotlight: Made it 0-11 for the year when down the field here (7f) a fortnight ago; however, he was in pretty good heart previously and his last win came over C&D last October; not written off.
runners.comment: Down the field here two weeks ago but this C&D winner was in pretty good heart previously
runners.owner: L Bond/Sheikh Aymen Jawad Al Hamandi/Ptr

runners.name: Camera Shy
runners.spotlight: Won over 7f here in March and not beaten far when fourth of seven at Ayr (7f, good to firm) in May when last seen; however, he's returning from a three-month break and 7f is probably his optimum trip.
runners.comment: Returns from a break; won over 7f here in March but that's probably his optimum trip
runners.owner: The Horse Watchers 13 And Michael Dods

runners.name: Fierce
runners.spotlight: Only sixth at Newcastle (5f, AW) last time but placed over 5f on his other three starts this season; his three wins have come over 6f and he could have a part to play back up in trip; effective here.
runners.comment: Placed over 5f three times this season and his three wins have come at 6f; possibilities

runners.name: Baba Reza
runners.spotlight: 8yo who has been beaten ten times since his last win in July 2024 but he's been placed on both starts this summer (6f, soft/Tapeta); chance.
runners.comment: Placed on both starts this summer and he's in with a chance

runners.name: Dorney Lake
runners.spotlight: Won at Doncaster (5.6f, good to firm) last month and runner-up at Pontefract (6f, good to firm) next time, splitting a well-treated winner and a next-time-out scorer; well beaten at York last time but was scuppered by a high draw; third over C&D in April and could be involved.
runners.comment: In good form prior to being scuppered by a high draw at York last time; could be involved
runners.owner: Mrs C M Clarke, Foulrice Park Racing Ltd

runners.name: Beattie Is Back
runners.spotlight: He's struggled to get competitive on turf on his four starts since May, albeit he fared best in the near-side group at York a fortnight ago; Tapeta seems to be his preferred surface and he's 5lb lower than when going close at Wolverhampton (7f) in February; no surprise to see a big run.
runners.comment: Hasn't shone on turf since May but Tapeta seems to be his preferred surface; handy mark
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd

races.race_name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Ultrasoul
runners.spotlight: Had no problem with the longer trip when winning on his Chester reappearance (1m2f, good to soft) in June and now bids for a four-timer off a 4lb higher mark; should stay this far on breeding and high on list in current mood.
runners.comment: Bids for four-timer off a 4lb higher mark; should stay this far on breeding; high on list

runners.name: Jimmy Speaking
runners.spotlight: Just 2lb higher than when winning over 7f here in April, but is unraced beyond 1m1f and this looks a tough race in which to prove his stamina.
runners.comment: 7f course winner; unraced beyond 1m1f; this is a tough race in which to prove his stamina

runners.name: Per Contra
runners.spotlight: Infrequent winner but is 2-4 on Tapeta, his latest win coming from 3lb lower at Newcastle (1m2f) last September; could go well at a price.
runners.comment: 2-4 on Tapeta, his latest winning coming from 3lb lower at Newcastle last September

runners.name: Cloth Of Gold
runners.spotlight: Seems to have an aversion to anything away from soft ground on turf, but is proving consistent on the AW (2312); one for the shortlist.
runners.comment: Is proving consistent on the AW (2312); one for the shortlist

runners.name: French Duke
runners.spotlight: Made a winning stable debut at Meydan (12.5f, good) in January, but held in three starts since; ran with credit in one previous go on the AW, but others are more compelling.
runners.comment: Held in three starts since winning in Meydan; others are more compelling

runners.name: Spinning Wheel
runners.spotlight: Looked a progressive sort last year (3-5) and ran well to finish runner-up on his Goodwood reappearance (1m6f, good) in May; soft ground the likely reason for his dismal effort at Epsom (1m4f) on Derby Day and better expected if taking to the AW.
runners.comment: Progressive sort before poor effort on soft ground at Epsom; better expected on AW debut
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum

runners.name: Port Of London
runners.spotlight: 2-5 last year, his latest success coming on his first start since being gelded, at Lingfield (1m2f, Polytrack) in December (form has worked out well); 6lb higher on this return, but still respected especially if market positive.
runners.comment: 2-5 last year; 6lb higher on this return but still respected especially if market positive

runners.name: Say What You See
runners.spotlight: Five wins since July last year including one over 1m4f here; cheekpieces seemed to work well at York (1m2f, good) last time and a player in his hat-trick bid despite a 6lb rise.
runners.comment: 1m4f course winner; cheekpieces worked well last time and a player in his hat-trick bid

runners.name: Let's Dream
runners.spotlight: Recorded narrow wins on his final start of last year at York (1m2f, good) and on his Chester reappearance (1m2f, good) in May, but held in last two starts including when behind King's Code back at Chester; half-brother to an AW winner, but he needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Twice held since his successful reappearance and needs to bounce back; AW debut

runners.name: King's Code
runners.spotlight: 10-30 on the AW including two wins over this trip at Kempton; recent turf form has been patchy, but he is 2lb lower than when last successful on the AW so by no means written off.
runners.comment: 10-30 on the AW; 2lb lower than when last successful on the AW; by no means written off

runners.name: El Burhan
runners.spotlight: Has won four races and still looks to be improving; ran better than it looked when fifth of 13 in the Rosebery on his reappearance at Kempton (1m3f, Polytrack) in March and looked in need of a return to further when fourth of 11 at Chester (1m2f, good) in May; off three months, but has won fresh; high on list.
runners.comment: Has won four races and still looks to be improving; off three months, but has won fresh

runners.name: Virtual Rock
runners.spotlight: Won a Listed race in France (1m4f, heavy) in April 2023, but not seen since successful over hurdles for Robert Eddery in July 2024; market should be revealing on his debut for another new yard (same owner) after such a long absence.
runners.comment: Not seen in 741 days; market should be revealing on his debut for another new yard

runners.name: Astro King
runners.spotlight: Has been smart in his time and is now 10lb lower than when winning the 2023 Cambridgeshire; record on the AW as a 3yo read 121, but a leap of faith is required based on his two efforts since returning from a long absence (and wind surgery).
runners.comment: 10lb lower than when winning the 2023 Cambridgeshire, but has shown little lately

races.race_name: Download The At The Races App Handicap

runners.name: Meet Me In Meraki
runners.spotlight: Three-time AW winner (9.5f-1m4f), most recently last October off 3lb higher; has run well in two starts at Ffos Las since returning from a 95-day break, latest when second of four behind an improving rival three weeks ago; makes the shortlist back on the AW.
runners.comment: Bumped into an improving rival when second of four at Ffos Las last time; shortlisted
runners.owner: Spiers & Hartwell Ltd & Mrs E Evans

runners.name: Golspie
runners.spotlight: Sole win on the AW came at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) in December; has posted some good placed efforts since and left the impression he's still in form when sixth of 13 there over 1m3f last time; can be slowly away but is considered.
runners.comment: 1-30 on the AW; left the impression he's still in form at Newcastle latest; considered

runners.name: Dingwall
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner (8.5f-1m2f) who is often slowly away; ran well when third at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) last time in a race won by a subsequent winner; has since left Iain Jardine having been bought for £5,000; has the hood removed for his stable debut and has stamina to prove.
runners.comment: Ran well over 1m2f on his final start for Iain Jardine; hood removed and stamina a concern

runners.name: Into Combat
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden who has run below market expectations in three starts this year; however, he did shape better than the bare result over 1m6f two weeks ago, taking up the running 4f out before his stamina gave way; should be suited by this drop back in trip.
runners.comment: 0-8 but did shape better than the bare result over 1m6f at Wolverhampton; back in trip

runners.name: Distinction
runners.spotlight: Three-time AW winner and he's 9lb lower than for the most recent success; never featured from off the pace at Wolverhampton (9.5f, AW) two weeks ago but it would be no surprise to see him bounce back now returning to 1m3f.
runners.comment: 9lb below his last winning mark; never featured from off the pace at Wolverhampton latest

runners.name: Norflondonforever
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark, tongue tied for the first time, at Kempton (1m) last April but he's struggled in three starts since returning from a 400-day absence; others have stronger claims.
runners.comment: Won over 1m at Kempton last April; struggled in three starts this year; others stronger

runners.name: It's Only Fun
runners.spotlight: Two wins, including one over this C&D in May off a 5lb lower mark than today's; respectable effort when fourth behind younger rivals over 1m6f at Southwell ten days ago and won't mind this drop back in trip; could go well.
runners.comment: C&D winner in May off 5lb lower; respectable effort here over 1m6f last time; may go well

runners.name: Luan
runners.spotlight: Off the mark when winning at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) in June and followed up at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) next time; has since left James Ferguson; holds good claims off this 6lb higher mark on his stable debut.
runners.comment: Registered AW wins in last two starts for James Ferguson; 6lb higher on yard debut

runners.name: Blackwaterfoot
runners.spotlight: Won at Pontefract (1m2f, good) last July but he was well beaten on his next two starts for Paul Attwater, and finished down the field on his stable debut at Kempton (1m3f) in June; needs to take a big step forward from that first start for 230 days.
runners.comment: Won at Pontefract last July; down the field on his stable debut at Kempton in June

runners.name: Titainium
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner, most recently at Wetherby (1m2f, good to firm) last June off a 5lb higher mark; however, he's struggled in four starts since and now has a bit to prove; down in class.
runners.comment: Struggled in four starts since winning at Wetherby last June; has a bit to prove

runners.name: Sisterandbrother
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner whose most recent success came at Beverley (1m4f, good to firm) last month; below his best at Chester last time but drops back into class 6 company with claims.
runners.comment: Won at Beverley last month; below his best at Chester but drops back down in grade; claims

runners.name: Junkyard Dog
runners.spotlight: Sole win came at Navan (1m2f, good) last April when trained by Joseph O'Brien; ran his best race since joining current stable when second of five at Carlisle (1m3f, good; first-time visor) last month but his task will now be to back that up.
runners.comment: Won in Ireland last April; ran his best race since joining this yard at Carlisle latest
runners.owner: A Sinclair, David Carroll & G Gibson

runners.name: Cavalry Call
runners.spotlight: Won twice for the Crisford stable but he struggled for Mike Smith, and has failed to beat a rival in each of his two starts for current stable; lots to prove.
runners.comment: Has failed to beat a rival in two starts for this stable

races.race_name: Westcare Home Care Claiming Hurdle

runners.name: Raydamann
runners.spotlight: Maiden winner hit the wall in handicaps after finishing 10l third to recent Galway Hurdle winner at last year's Punchestown festival; enjoyed the drop in grade when easily winning similar contest over C&D in June; poor Flat run since, but doesn't seem to enjoy that code anymore.
runners.comment: Enjoyed the drop in grade when easily winning similar contest over C&D in June

runners.name: Oh So Charming
runners.spotlight: Won a handicap off 111 last year, so has come down a lot in the ratings; has run in several claimers and was second of five in this last year; chased home Rich Belief at Wexford in May, held in handicaps since.
runners.comment: Chased home Rich Belief at Wexford in May, held in handicaps since

runners.name: Howdoyalikeherhome
runners.spotlight: Did well in handicaps last summer, winning over 2m6f and placed three times; had a couple of spins over fences in early summer; going okay when departing four out in 3m claimer at Roscommon, poor run since; no weight and big chance on paper, but would prefer farther.
runners.comment: Did well in handicaps last summer; no weight and big chance on paper, would prefer farther

runners.name: Rich Belief
runners.spotlight: Grand dual-purpose performer has done a lot more Flat racing than hurdling in recent years; had Oh So Charming and Warm In Gorey behind when winning one of these at Wexford in May; 10l third to ready winner Raydamann over C&D the following month, and 4lb pull may not be enough to turn things around.
runners.comment: 10l third to ready winner Raydamann over C&D; 4lb pull may not be enough to turn tables

runners.name: Truckers Cruising
runners.spotlight: Modest hurdles form; won heavy-ground chase at Ayr during the winter; well beaten lately, including in Galway festival chase latest; third runner for yard.
runners.comment: Modest hurdles form; won heavy-ground chase at Ayr in December; third runner for yard
runners.owner: Ed Mulligan & John Finnegan & Aileen Saunders & Ann Holton

runners.name: Warm In Gorey
runners.spotlight: Three wins over hurdles; made the running when around 9l off Rich Belief at Wexford in June, and extra 7lb claimed now; backed that up when placed in Downpatrick handicap, but well beaten latest.
runners.comment: Around 9l off Rich Belief at Wexford in June, and extra 7lb claimed now

runners.name: Slowdownbarney
runners.spotlight: AW winner over 1m6f; modest hurdles form in three maidens and a handicap, and holds the lowest rating of these; visor on for the first time over jumps.
runners.comment: AW winner over 1m6f; modest hurdles form in three maidens and a handicap

runners.name: Bryson
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden over hurdles; second of 14 in Downpatrick handicap in June, but well beaten when favourite back there last month; stiff task at the weights.
runners.comment: Second in Downpatrick handicap in June, but well held when favourite back there last month
runners.owner: Nigel O'Hare & Mark Devlin & Philip Smith

runners.name: God Of Thunder
runners.spotlight: Was in better form last year when winning at Limerick over hurdles and on the Flat; struggled over hurdles subsequently and this will be his first run over flights since October; regressive on the level this year, although fair effort last time at Killarney.
runners.comment: Was in better form last year when winning at Limerick over hurdles and on the Flat

runners.name: Presenting Lad
runners.spotlight: Has won six races for local yard, four hurdles and two chases; hasn't competed much in this discipline since winning at Kilbeggan nearly two years ago; good run over fences at Tramore in May, poor since.
runners.comment: Six-time winner hasn't run much in this code since winning at Kilbeggan in 2024

races.race_name: Martin Reilly Hyundai Mares Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Circus Hill
runners.spotlight: Runner-up three times in bumpers here (lost one in the stewards' room last time); probably ran to a mid-90s mark in sole hurdles start over C&D in May (third and fifth have won since) and a reproduction may well be good enough.
runners.comment: Runner-up three times in bumpers here and fair fourth in C&D contest on hurdling debut
runners.owner: Dermot J Kelly & E J Burns & Sandra C Kelly

runners.name: My Elusive Mate
runners.spotlight: From a top yard, but has been tailed off in maidens at Ballinrobe and Kilbeggan.
runners.comment: From a top yard, but has been tailed off in maidens at Ballinrobe and Kilbeggan

runners.name: Nelliestar
runners.spotlight: Hillstar mare has decent pedigree, but Flat form in 11 starts couldn't be much worse; hurdles debut.
runners.comment: Hillstar mare has decent pedigree, but Flat form in 11 starts couldn't be much worse

runners.name: Speisialta
runners.spotlight: Has ability and no bigger than 9-1 in three bumpers, but she's keen-going and tricky; beaten 24l in fourth at Punchestown in January; refused to race next time; too free when well beaten at Wexford; will need to settle better on hurdling debut.
runners.comment: Has ability and no bigger than 9-1 in three bumpers, but she's keen-going and tricky

runners.name: Saoirses Choice
runners.spotlight: Not a bad run when fourth in a Limerick bumper, beaten 15l; didn't build on that last time; first run over jumps and dam and grandam were fair hurdlers.
runners.comment: Fourth in a Limerick bumper, beaten 15l; didn't build on that last time; hurdling debut

runners.name: Sea Feliz
runners.spotlight: Getaway half-sister to 2m-2m4f hurdle winner Morricone; dam bumper winner, half-sister to useful bumper and 2m-2m5f hurdle/chase winner Encore Champs, out of Irish Cesarewitch winner and useful hurdler Dani California; took a walk in the market and looked clueless early on when tailed off in 2m4f maiden at Roscommon.
runners.comment: Nice pedigree; big market drifter and looked clueless early on when tailed off on debut

runners.name: Kilgharrahs Love
runners.spotlight: Modest maiden on the Flat, but has run well at times on testing ground; hurdling debut.
runners.comment: Modest maiden on the Flat, but has run well at times on testing ground; hurdling debut

runners.name: Maroel
runners.spotlight: Blue Bresil filly only cost E2,000 as 3yo, but has a decent pedigree; dam dual bumper winner, closely related to 1m4f Flat and smart 2m-3m hurdle winner Fire Dragon, half-sister to 1m5f Group 3 winner Spendent and smart 2m hurdler Rigmarole.
runners.comment: Blue Bresil filly only cost E2,000 as 3yo, but has decent pedigree; dam dual bumper winner

runners.name: An Lachin Beag
runners.spotlight: Beaten 22l and 38l in bumpers; half-brother is a useful jumper for Nicky Henderson, so she might improve for obstacles.
runners.comment: Beaten 22l and 38l in bumpers; half-brother is a useful jumper for Nicky Henderson

runners.name: Idaho Expresso
runners.spotlight: 1-9 in point-to-points; poor form in first two starts over hurdles; now tried in a combination of headgear.
runners.comment: 1-9 in point-to-points; poor form in first two starts over hurdles; headgear combination

runners.name: Glendaars Crystal
runners.spotlight: Big prices and big margins of defeat in three maidens.
runners.comment: Big prices and big margins of defeat in three maidens.

runners.name: Moonwing
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in Cork maiden hurdle last month.
runners.comment: Tailed off in Cork maiden hurdle last month.

runners.name: I Dont Really Care
runners.spotlight: Poet's Word homebred out of 2m5f-3m hurdle/chase winner; tailed off in a bumper at Thurles in December.
runners.comment: Poet's Word homebred out of 2m5f-3m hurdle/chase winner; tailed off in bumper at Thurles

races.race_name: SIS Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Justicialism
runners.spotlight: Won a couple of hurdles at four; second three times in a row in handicaps between this trip and 2m4f in April/May and okay runs over fences since; cheekpieces swapped for visor.
runners.comment: Second three times in a row in handicaps between this trip and 2m4f in April/May

runners.name: Go To Town
runners.spotlight: Fourth in handicaps at Clonmel (extended 2m) and when favourite over extended 2m4f here last month; no extra in straight then, and drop back in trip might help.
runners.comment: Fourth at Clonmel (extended 2m) and when favourite over extended 2m4f here

runners.name: Ripsnorter
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; Roscommon bumper winner a year ago for Andy Slattery; has run fine in three maidens and worthy of consideration if he gets in.
runners.comment: Roscommon bumper winner for Andy Slattery; has run fine in three maidens; reserve

runners.name: Stormy Jenn
runners.spotlight: First reserve; dual Flat winner yet to win in this code but was placed twice in handicaps last year, notably when third of 24 at Navan in November; may have needed latest run at Downpatrick.
runners.comment: Dual Flat winner yet to win in this code, placed twice in handicaps last year; reserve

runners.name: Andyourbirdcansing
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been here, maiden over this trip and 2m4f handicap last time on her fourth outing of the summer; up 7lb for that.
runners.comment: Both wins have been here, maiden over this trip and 2m4f handicap last time; up 7lb

runners.name: General Clermont
runners.spotlight: Two wins over fences; just 1-34 over hurdles, but placed many times; touched off over 2m4f at Killarney this time last year; quiet so far this season and would prefer farther.
runners.comment: Two wins over fences; just 1-34 over hurdles, but placed many times; would prefer farther

runners.name: Steps In The Sand
runners.spotlight: Grand mare rattled up a hat-trick on the Flat last year and one of her two wins over hurdles came here in 2024; third of seven in C&D mares' handicap hurdle before a poor run in 1m6f Galway handicap which she won last year.
runners.comment: Third of seven in C&D mares' handicap hurdle before a poor run in 1m6f Galway handicap

runners.name: Il Pirata
runners.spotlight: Not shamed in a bumper and three completed starts in maidens; respected yard and he's a possible improver in handicaps.
runners.comment: Not shamed in a bumper and three completed starts in maidens; respected yard

runners.name: Backinabit
runners.spotlight: Modest form for two previous trainers; much-improved in first-time blinkers on second start for yard when winning at Wexford (2m1f, good) but weakened and beaten 11l when favourite on return to that venue; scratched (due to soft ground) from chase at Roscommon on Tuesday.
runners.comment: Much-improved in first-time blinkers when winning at Wexford; beaten 11l on return visit

runners.name: Phoenix Arizona
runners.spotlight: Has shown promise over C&D last two starts; fourth in claimer on final start for previous yard and well-backed third in higher grade of handicap last month, when wrong at the weights; had placed form on testing ground in points; new headgear combination.
runners.comment: Well-backed third in higher grade of handicap over C&D last month; new headgear combo

runners.name: Glenriver
runners.spotlight: Made the frame in Downpatrick handicap in 2024 when with Dermot McLoughlin, but poor form overall; missed last year and made no impact in points early this year; well beaten on stable debut last month.
runners.comment: Fourth in Downpatrick handicap in 2024, poor form overall; well beaten on stable debut

runners.name: Lady Victrix
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; modest form in maidens and too keen in this headgear on recent handicap debut over 3m at Wexford.
runners.comment: Modest form in maidens and too keen in this headgear on recent handicap debut; reserve

runners.name: Georginas Jet
runners.spotlight: Placed in three handicaps last August at up to 2m6f; 10l winner over this trip at Downpatrick in June; held when favourite twice since; good ground is important to her.
runners.comment: 10l winner over this trip at Downpatrick in June; held when favourite twice since

runners.name: Frontier Rose
runners.spotlight: Has been getting better with each handicap run this term, and only beaten 8l over 2m4f here last time (third won since, Go To Town fourth) when O'Keeffe rode her for the first time; travelled into it well that day and this trip might suit better.
runners.comment: Beaten 8l over 2m4f here latest (third won since, Go To Town fourth) when O'Keeffe rode

runners.name: Copper Rocker
runners.spotlight: Interesting trainer/rider combination but filly has shown little so far; wasn't too far off the leaders when walking through the second-last at Roscommon last time.
runners.comment: Interesting trainer/rider combination but filly has shown little so far

runners.name: Nothing Da Now
runners.spotlight: Poor form in bumpers and maidens and has been off almost seven months; handicap debut.
runners.comment: Poor form in bumpers and maidens and has been off almost seven months; handicap debut

runners.name: Mon Sheriffe
runners.spotlight: Maiden has been placed just once in 14 starts over hurdles, when third on winter ground at Navan in December; beaten 18l when fifth at Kilbeggan.
runners.comment: Maiden has been placed just once in 14 runs over hurdles; beaten 18l at Kilbeggan latest
runners.owner: T Leopold, P Smith, D P Connolly & C Connolly

runners.name: Boltlander
runners.spotlight: Poor form for Gordon Elliott and in two starts since returning to his breeder; has been wearing a hood, new headgear combination tried now.
runners.comment: Poor form for Gordon Elliott and in two starts since returning to his breeder

runners.name: Moulane West
runners.spotlight: Sole win in 35 starts over hurdles came first time out last year when he won C&D handicap by 10 lengths; lost form towards the end of last season; not a bad run here in June when mid-field behind subsequent dual Galway winner Timurshah.
runners.comment: C&D winner last year; mid-field behind subsequent dual Galway winner Timurshah here latest

races.race_name: Mulhern Leonard Chartered Accountants Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Cut The Rope
runners.spotlight: Naas bumper winner in 2023 but hasn't added to that and is 0-13 hurdling, going closest in 2m6f Downpatrick maiden last summer; has run creditably in handicaps, latest when mistake last at Punchestown in June; strong claims back in a weak maiden, albeit has to concede weight.
runners.comment: Each-way claims back in maiden company, albeit has to concede weight
runners.owner: Brian P Whelan & Thomas J Quinn

runners.name: Minella Moon Shine
runners.spotlight: Was in the process of running a big race on point-to-point debut in 2024 when falling; absent for over two years until just denied in 2m Roscommon maiden hurdle last month, having travelled best going to the last; not as effective upped to 2m4f on softer ground at same venue on Tuesday, however, so seems a doubtful runner.
runners.comment: Just denied on hurdles bow at Roscommon after 2 years off, but below best there on Tuesday

runners.name: Fuusland
runners.spotlight: Jet Away gelding is first foal of a bumper and 2m3f/2m4f hurdle winner; early unseat on Roscommon debut last month and six days later keen and tended to jump left when a remote fourth at Downpatrick; probably best watched for now.
runners.comment: Jumping let him down both starts last month; probably best watched for now

runners.name: Tommy Go Maith
runners.spotlight: Little sign of promise in four starts and can't be fancied; cheekpieces tried.
runners.comment: Little sign of promise in four starts and can't be fancied; cheekpieces tried

runners.name: Fox Walk
runners.spotlight: Walk In The Park 5yo cost 22,000euros as a foal and 38,000euros as a 3yo; first foal; dam 1m7f hurdle winner, out of 2m hurdle winning half-sister to Grand National winner Rule The World; Necarne point-to-point winner in May (good-to-yielding) for Eamonn Doyle now debuts under rules and market may prove best guide.
runners.comment: Necarne point-to-point winner; market best guide on rules debut

runners.name: San Patricio
runners.spotlight: Dragon Pulse half-brother to 2m4f/2m7f chase winner Moor End; dam modest Flat maiden, is out of half-sister to Dubai World Cup winner Electrocutionist; debutant likely best watched.
runners.comment: Half-brother to 2m4f/2m7f chase winner Moor End; debutant likely best watched

runners.name: Ivana d'Alco
runners.spotlight: Turtulla point-to-point winner for Jonathan Fogarty in January; ran okay to two out before weakening on last month's hurdles debut in a 2m Kilbeggan maiden won by a better-fancied stablemate, so can be expected to improve for that; tongue-tie now added to hood worn on debut and goes up in trip; won't have to be anything special to take this.
runners.comment: Points' winner expected to improve for recent hurdles debut effort and has to be respected

runners.name: Mr Caulfield
runners.spotlight: Valirann gelding won Tattersalls Farm point-to-point in May but never really counted on last month's hurdles debut at Ballinrobe; big improvement needed.
runners.comment: Points' winner needs to improve massively on recent hurdles debut effort

runners.name: Turlough Abu
runners.spotlight: Nothing so far on the Flat and in three attempts over hurdles in Ballinrobe maidens.
runners.comment: Nothing so far on the Flat and in three attempts over hurdles in Ballinrobe maidens

races.race_name: Lighthouse At Clifford Electrical Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: You Make Me Smile
runners.spotlight: Won here under both codes last year, including 2m2f mares' handicap hurdle off 81; best hurdle run this year when a clear second in 2m3f Downpatrick mares handicap in June (good), poor run on the Flat at Tramore since; unproven over this far.
runners.comment: Won twice here last year; Downpatrick second augurs well if staying longer trip
runners.owner: T & R Hennessy & A Fahy Partnership

runners.name: Lilac Lady
runners.spotlight: Six of seven runs over hurdles have come here, notably last month when getting off the mark in handicap at this trip in first-time tongue-tie, making all and seeing it out well on good ground; 7lb rise for that so a career-best required now.
runners.comment: Last month's all-the-way C&D winner up 7lb so career-best needed to follow up

runners.name: Whiskey Serenade
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point winner for Colin Bowe is now 0-9 hurdling, standout run on yard debut last month when second in 2m5f Bellewstown handicap, having led at the last; didn't appear to stay 2m6f at Ballinrobe 17 days later; respected back slightly in trip.
runners.comment: Didn't appear to stay 2m6f at Ballinrobe, respected back slightly in trip

runners.name: Run For The Border
runners.spotlight: Won 2m3f Limerick maiden last October and ran well there in 2m4f handicap in May; career-best last month when staying-on second in 2m6f Ballinrobe handicap; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Career-best last month when staying on second in 2m6f Ballinrobe handicap; shortlisted

runners.name: Jupiter Du Gite
runners.spotlight: Won over hurdles and fences in Britain on soft/heavy; standout effort for current yard came at Killarney last month when coming home strongly to be beaten a nose in 2m5f handicap hurdle (good), after being a bit short of room and having to be switched in closing stages; up 3lb for that but should go well.
runners.comment: Just failed to get up at Killarney over same trip; 3lb higher but should go well

runners.name: In The Minus
runners.spotlight: Won Galway 3yo maiden in October; no impact in conditions races over hurdles since and never sighted in competitive Galway handicap last week; handicapper relenting.
runners.comment: 4yo hasn't been progressing but handicapper relenting

runners.name: Cornmarket
runners.spotlight: All three hurdle wins have come here at 2m4f and 3m2f on decent ground; standout run this year when just failing to get up over 3m2f last month (good); tame Galway effort last week but has to be respected back here with such a good record at the track.
runners.comment: All three wins have come here, also just denied over 3m2f on penultimate; contender
runners.owner: John J Cullen & Michael C Barrett

runners.name: Bruant
runners.spotlight: Gained his second win over hurdles when landing 2m3f Downpatrick handicap in May; withdrawn twice on good ground before allowed to take his chance at Galway last week but never counted on similar ground when midfield over 2m; back up in trip here, any easing in the ground would help his chances.
runners.comment: Midfield at Galway last week; up in trip here, any easing in the ground would help

runners.name: Littlebiggie
runners.spotlight: Killarney mares' maiden winner in 2024 and added 2m7f Ballinrobe mares' beginners' chase last September; returned from five months' absence with good fourth in 3m1f Killarney handicap hurdle last month, not quite getting home under positive ride; back in trip here and big run expected.
runners.comment: Killarney comeback run augurs well, drop in trip to suit too

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race

runners.name: Carleys Lilly
runners.spotlight: Solid fourth in a 2m Clonmel maiden hurdle on debut in May and best of two efforts since on latest when staying-on third of 11 in C&D bumper last month (good); one to consider.
runners.comment: Last month's C&D third puts her in the mix

runners.name: Chanson d'Argent
runners.spotlight: Kingston Hill mare is second foal of a bumper/2m hurdle winner, a half-sister to useful 2m4f hurdle/chase winner Ballyarthur; headgear combination on for debut, probably best watched.
runners.comment: Out of a bumper winner; headgear combination on for debut, probably best watched

runners.name: Missouri Snow
runners.spotlight: Cheaply bought Mizzou mare is sister to 2m6f hurdle winner Nothing Hectic; dam unraced half-sister to useful 2m chaser The Wicketkeeper and useful French jumper La Zingarella; successful debut in March in 3-finisher Oldcastle mares' point-to-point (soft-to-heavy); interesting if any market support arrives on rules debut, encouraging jockey booking.
runners.comment: Debut winner of point' in March; interesting if any market support arrives on rules debut

runners.name: Ballito Beauty
runners.spotlight: Dam 2m2f hurdle winner, half-sister to useful bumper and 2m-2m1f hurdle/chase winner Whatswrongwithyou, out of unraced half-sister to useful bumper/2m hurdle winner No Where To Hyde; market best guide on debut.
runners.comment: Shantaram 5yo is out of a winning hurdler; market best guide on debut

runners.name: Peat Sounds
runners.spotlight: Hillstar mare is half-sister to seven winners inc Sizing Tennessee (high-class bumper and 2m-3m2f hurdler/chaser), Mount Ida (smart bumper and 2m-3m2f hurdle/chase) and Bargy Lady (bumper and 2m-2m6f hurdle/chase); dam 8.7f Flat and 2m1f hurdle/chase winner; nicely-bred debutante from top yard, demands utmost respect.
runners.comment: Nicely-bred debutante from top yard, demands utmost respect

runners.name: Poet's Creek
runners.spotlight: Poet's Word mare is first foal of a point-to-point winner, closely related to 2m5f-3m1f hurdle/chase winner Menindee, half-sister to 2m5f-3m hurdle winner Another Mattie; newcomer best watched unless market speaks.
runners.comment: Newcomer best watched unless market speaks

runners.name: A Chairde Go Leir
runners.spotlight: Valirann filly cost 1,400euros as a foal; first foal; dam unraced half-sister to 3m hurdle/chase winner Lunar Contact, out of unraced sister to Champion Bumper and smart 2m2f-2m4f hurdler/chase Briar Hill; debutante worth a market check
runners.comment: Debutante worth a market check

runners.name: River Moy
runners.spotlight: E3,000 F (E5,000 vendor 3yo); fourth foal; closely related to 2m hurdle winner Crying Lightning; dam unraced half-sister to useful winners Guitar Pete (2m-2m5f hurdle/chase) and Somethingwonderful (bumper/2m hurdle); some late headway on Ballinrobe debut in May; potential improver.
runners.comment: Some late headway on Ballinrobe debut in May; potential improver

runners.name: Tanga Mugi
runners.spotlight: Every chance when falling two out in Lisronagh point-to-point before bolting up at Necarne; subsequently bought for 32,000GBP and has to be respected on bumper debut (having been ballotted out at Galway last week).
runners.comment: Necarne points' winner has to be respected on bumper debut

runners.name: Hope And Mercy
runners.spotlight: Idaho mare out of unraced half-sister to smart 2m-2m5f hurdle/chase winner Go Roger Go; unseated on debut at last year's Galway festival and absent until weakening in straight at Punchestown in June, albeit only beaten 14l; not one to totally rule out.
runners.comment: Ran okay at Punchestown, not one to totally rule out

runners.name: Pamelaisbrass
runners.spotlight: Nothing as yet in three bumpers.
runners.comment: Nothing as yet in three bumpers

runners.name: Loughdoo
runners.spotlight: Remote fourth in this race last year (good) and soundly beaten both starts since on softer ground.
runners.comment: Remote fourth in this race last year (good) and soundly beaten both starts since on soft

races.race_name: Corinthian Amateur Jockeys' Handicap

runners.name: Beach Point
runners.spotlight: Won twice over C&D (good/soft) last summer; has reached the frame on four of his five 2026 starts but beaten 6l when fourth at York latest and the return to Sandown needs to help him recapture his peak form.
runners.comment: Beaten 6l when fourth latest but two C&D wins last year so return to best no surprise
runners.owner: John & Peter Seabrook And Tim Fisher

runners.name: What's The Plan
runners.spotlight: AW maiden winner and has shown better form in defeat in handicaps this year, beaten at short odds but running his best RPR when second of four at Lingfield (1m2f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; likely to go well.
runners.comment: Running well in defeat in handicaps this year and should go well again

runners.name: Impierious
runners.spotlight: Well-related gelding who has shown a fairly useful level of ability when third in maiden/novice events over 1m (good/good to firm) this year; while it's tough to argue an opening mark in the 80s looks generous he's unexposed and his pedigree suggests this longer trip will help; also visored first time.
runners.comment: Third in three 1m starts; opening mark not obviously generous but he is unexposed
runners.owner: Hasmonean Racing, S Hope & S Barrow

runners.name: Epictetus
runners.spotlight: Yet to add to his Group 3 win at Glorious Goodwood three years ago but placed several times this year, including third at Lingfield (1m2f, good to firm) on Saturday; prior to that he was beaten only a neck over 1m4f at Epsom (good to firm) under Megan Jordan; tongue-tied first time.
runners.comment: Long time without a win but several good efforts this year, including under Megan Jordon

runners.name: Drumstick
runners.spotlight: Tailed off on hurdle/yard debut last autumn but proved a different proposition after a break when successful back on the Flat at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) in May, pulling over 4l clear and posting his peak RPR; evidently capable when fresh so being off for a further three months isn't a concern but he'll require another career best off 7lb higher.
runners.comment: Had plenty to spare back on Flat at Windsor in May but another career best needed up 7lb

runners.name: Warning Sign
runners.spotlight: Two Sandown wins under David Dunsdon in 2025, including this race on good (other win on good to firm); back on form returned to turf and reunited with his owner/rider when seeing off seven rivals at Goodwood (1m, soft) eight weeks ago; raised 6lb but his good record in these races affords him plenty of respect.
runners.comment: C&D winner who was better than ever when scoring at Goodwood in June; up 6lb

runners.name: Arcadian Nights
runners.spotlight: Has a good 10-34 record on AW but his turf strike-rate is only 2-19; has a lower mark in this sphere but off since finishing last of six at Wolverhampton in March and a watching brief is the percentage call.
runners.comment: 10-34 on AW but only 2-19 on turf; off five months and possibly best watched

races.race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Elevating
runners.spotlight: Well-backed runner-up on last month's debut at York (6f, good to firm); down the field at Goodwood (7f, good to firm) since but failed to see out the trip in that warm maiden; could be suited by this stiff 5f; respected.
runners.comment: Promising 6f second on debut then failed to see out 7f; could be suited by this stiff 7f

runners.name: Catching Dreams
runners.spotlight: Recovered from slow start to finish second at 3-1 on recent debut at Lingfield (5f, good to firm); his dam was a useful 5f/6f winner from a talented sprinting family and he's a leading contender on this second run.
runners.comment: Recovered from slow start to finish second on recent debut and he's a leading contender

runners.name: Menhaal
runners.spotlight: 260,000gns yearling who has been a short-priced favourite for both starts, when seventh at Newbury (6f, good) then fifth at Nottingham (6f, good); gelded since last run and perhaps that will help unlock the potential in his attractive pedigree; interesting to see if he's again strong in the betting.
runners.comment: Twice an unplaced favourite; gelded, which may help unlock the potential in his pedigree

runners.name: Crazee In Havana
runners.spotlight: Failed to settle and weakened into 8l sixth of nine at 10-1 on recent debut at Ascot (6f, good to firm); however, that run may have got the freshness out of him and he has a useful pedigree; drops to 5f and could get closer to the target today.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten on recent debut but has a useful pedigree and he's likely to improve

runners.name: Pulse Of Fire
runners.spotlight: 82,000gns yearling; fifth foal; Mehmas half-brother to four winners including Diamond Vega (6f-8.5f including 2yo/German Listed) and Marketplaceofideas (US 1m/8.5f turf; RPR 102); dam Listed-placed 5f winner (including 2yo; 92); likely to improve for this debut run but monitor the betting.
runners.comment: 82,000gns half-brother to 4 winners; likely to improve for this 1st run but check betting

runners.name: Kigali
runners.spotlight: Unplaced this summer on his first three starts (all 6f); gelded since latest outing on July 13; others are preferred.
runners.comment: Unplaced this summer on his first three starts; gelded since latest; others preferred
runners.owner: Mr And Mrs B V Sangster

runners.name: Vesper Honey
runners.spotlight: Yard is going well but she's been well beaten over 6f on her first two starts and it's probably best to look elsewhere.
runners.comment: Yard is going well but she's been well beaten over 6f on her first two starts

runners.name: Champagne Charlee
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way on his first two starts (6f, good to firm/AW); the first-time tongue-tie needs to make a massive difference.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way on his first two starts; wears a first-time tongue-tie

runners.name: Beach Noir
runners.spotlight: Well beaten at big odds on first two starts (7f/6f, good) and it's hard to envisage the drop to 5f prompting a transformation.
runners.comment: Well beaten at big odds on first two starts (7f/6f, good); transformation needed

races.race_name: Chasemore Farm EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Crown Ranger
runners.spotlight: Showed ability when fifth of eight at Leicester (7f, good) in June on his second start and the step up to 1m could suit this Camelot colt, but he takes on two very interesting newcomers and could again prove vulnerable.
runners.comment: Has shown ability but takes on two very interesting newcomers & could again be vulnerable

runners.name: First Law
runners.spotlight: 1,000,000gns yearling; eighth foal; closely related to 7f 2yo winner Victory Dance (including Listed), half-brother to four winners including Skitter Scatter (5f-7f 2yo including Group 1) and Skellet (7f/1m including 2yo/Listed); in top hands and this Too Darn Hot newcomer could play a leading role.
runners.comment: 1,000,000gns yearling; in top hands and could play a leading role on debut

runners.name: See The Mountain
runners.spotlight: 70,000gns yearling whose dam is from a classy family; green and tailed off when 12-1 on debut at Salisbury (7f, good to firm) in June; can leave that behind at some point but he may be best watched today.
runners.comment: Green and tailed off when 12-1 on debut at Salisbury (7f, good to firm) in June

runners.name: Flight Tracker
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; Sea The Stars brother to Group-placed 7f 2yo winner Macduff (RPR 106), half-brother to 1m3f AW winner Participle (86); dam 1m winner (93), half-sister to top-class miler Kingman, out of French 1,000 Guineas winner; trainer has won two of the last five runnings with newcomers who went on to win Group races; firmly in calculations on debut.
runners.comment: Stable has won two of the last five runnings with newcomers who went on to win Group races

races.race_name: Hwfa Williams - Founder Of Sandown Park Handicap

runners.name: Interstate
runners.spotlight: Neck runner-up at Southwell (1m, AW) last November on second and final 2yo start and it was the same outcome at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) a fortnight ago on his reappearance, when wearing first-time cheekpieces (retained); brings potential to this handicap debut and could have a big say.
runners.comment: Neck runner-up on last two starts and he brings potential to this handicap debut; player

runners.name: Edwin Hubble
runners.spotlight: 0-7 but he went close in a five-runner field at Windsor (11.4f, good to firm) in June on his second handicap start and ran respectably when fifth of 15 at Ascot (1m4f, good to firm) last time, albeit soundly beaten; this is less competitive and he could be involved in first-time blinkers.
runners.comment: 0-7 but went close two starts ago and he could be involved in first-time blinkers

runners.name: Elan d'Or
runners.spotlight: Nursery wins on final two starts last year (7f/1m, AW) and he returned to form when third of six at Newmarket (1m, good to firm) last month; today's longer trip could be within range for this Without Parole colt and he might not be far away.
runners.comment: Returned to form when third of six at Newmarket last month and he might not be far away

races.race_name: BetMGM 80s Day Saturday 29 August Handicap

runners.name: Thursday Girl
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on first three starts this year, including 1m course handicap debut (Ascending Star third), before taking advantage of a good opportunity in a novice at Nottingham (extended 1m, good to firm; made all) 19 days ago; ought to be fine back at 7f; likely to go well again.
runners.comment: Closely matched with Ascending Star on 1m course handicap form and has won a novice since

runners.name: Ascending Star
runners.spotlight: Gelded prior to making all and turning over a 1-5 shot in novice event at Lingfield (7.5f, good) on stable/seasonal debut; shaped as if possibly just stretched by 1m when third (Thursday Girl second) on course handicap debut (good) five weeks ago; the drop to 7f looks ideal and he's taken to get the better of Ed Walker's charge this time.
runners.comment: A place behind Thursday Girl on 1m course handicap debut but can turn tables down at 7f

runners.name: Sunny Smile
runners.spotlight: Matched the pick of his 2yo form when second over C&D (good to firm) last month but he was beaten 4.5l so needs to build on that; has subsequently had wind surgery; Oisin Murphy was on board last time but seemingly prefers Desert Shadow on this occasion.
runners.comment: Back on form when second over C&D latest but beaten 4.5l; had wind operation since

runners.name: Desert Shadow
runners.spotlight: Made it 11th time lucky when seeing off three rivals at Lingfield (7.5f, good to firm) three weeks ago but the majority of those starts have been over 1m2f+ so he is unexposed over this sort of trip; Oisin Murphy also has a very good record for the stable.
runners.comment: Having 11th start when off mark at Lingfield (fast turf) latest but is unexposed at 7f

runners.name: Lunario
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who won this race 12 months ago and bounced back to form out of the blue when springing a 33-1 surprise in 7f Ascot handicap (good to firm) 26 days ago; put back up 4lb but last year's success came off 5lb higher so he retains plenty of handicapping scope.
runners.comment: Won this race last year and back to form with 7f Ascot success last month

runners.name: Tavana
runners.spotlight: Showed she's down to a mark she can be competitive from when second of six in 7f Newbury handicap (good to firm) but will need to pull out a bit more if she's to get her head back in front.
runners.comment: Back on form when second at Newbury (7f, good to firm) latest but this demands more

races.race_name: Wasdell Group Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap

runners.name: Curran
runners.spotlight: Six-time winner, latterly in comfortable fashion at the expense of three rivals at Salisbury (1m6f, good to firm); strongly considered off 4lb higher; Charlie Tucker claims 7lb, replacing Oisin Murphy.
runners.comment: Easy winner at Salisbury latest; only beat three rivals but went up just 4lb

runners.name: Oasis Sunrise
runners.spotlight: Turf wins this season at Bath (1m), over C&D and Leicester (1m2f); ran well from off the pace at Ascot 12 days ago (1m4f); her good campaign could continue.
runners.comment: Fine run from off the pace at Ascot latest and her good campaign could continue

runners.name: Double Red
runners.spotlight: Got competitive some way out at Salisbury last time (1m2f, good to firm) and was mugged on the line; respected off 1lb higher, for all that he's yet to prove his stamina for this far.
runners.comment: Got competitive some way out at Salisbury last time (1m2f) and was mugged on the line

runners.name: Aravalli
runners.spotlight: C&D winner in July on second run for this yard and followed up again here over 1m2f; kept on for a 3l fourth at Sandown (1m2f) and returning to this trip will suit; 4lb higher than last time.
runners.comment: Kept on for a 3l fourth at Sandown (1m2f) and returning to this trip will suit

runners.name: Cosmo Brown
runners.spotlight: Improved for the hood when close up in his final novice in May (1m2f, good to firm) but was then tailed off on his handicap debut (1m4f); now gelded and needs respecting on the strength of that penultimate effort.
runners.comment: Now gelded and needs respecting on the strength of his penultimate effort

runners.name: Virtue Diligence
runners.spotlight: Beaten under 3l when upped to 1m4f for handicap debut at Salisbury (good to firm) and should have more to offer.
runners.comment: Beaten under 3l when upped to 1m4f for handicap debut at Salisbury

runners.name: Polemon
runners.spotlight: Three-time Flat winner (1m1f-1m4f) in Ireland and was also placed over jumps; however, brought down early and pulled up in two maiden hurdles for current yard and a visor replaces usual cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Three Flat wins; brought down early and pulled up in two maiden hurdles for current yard

races.race_name: Reecer Group Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Downonmainstreet
runners.spotlight: Dropped back to 5f at Sandown (good to firm) and still appeared to be learning on the job in finishing a close third behind a Haggas newcomer; clear claims.
runners.comment: Dropped back to 5f at Sandown (good to firm) and was close third to a Haggas newcomer
runners.owner: Mrs Paul Shanahan & Mrs M V Magnier

runners.name: Marzad
runners.spotlight: Fifth foal; half-sister to 6f/7f AW winner Miss Moonshine (RPR 64); dam unraced half-sister to AW winners Litotes (1m) and Ain't Talkin' (7f); would merit attention if popular in the betting.
runners.comment: Fifth foal; half-sister to 6f/7f AW winner Miss Moonshine (RPR 64); dam unraced

runners.name: Rogue Dakota
runners.spotlight: 70,000gns yearling; eighth foal; half-sister to seven winners including Jungle Cove (7f-1m2f; RPR 101; 2m hurdle), Main Desire (5f; 101), Magical Effect (5f-7f; 92) and Mini Magna (5f/5.7f 2yo; 86); dam 6f 2yo winner (95); has to be of interest.
runners.comment: 70,000gns yearling; eighth foal; half-sister to seven winners; interesting

runners.name: Calef
runners.spotlight: Has a BHA mark of 67 after five defeats, all at 5f; not progressing and looks vulnerable.
runners.comment: Has a BHA mark of 67 after five defeats, all at 5f; not progressing and looks vulnerable

races.race_name: Dunraven Windows Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap

runners.name: Solar Edge
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who couldn't adopt those tactics after a wide trip on the AW last time; had resumed better than ever and off same mark as for his near miss at Windsor (5f, good to firm).
runners.comment: Better than ever until enduring a wide trip on the AW; can be given another chance

runners.name: Moe's Legacy
runners.spotlight: Multiple winner who has been threatening further success and was close up despite a troubled run at Windsor ten days ago (good to firm); thereabouts.
runners.comment: Threatening further success and was close up despite a troubled run at Windsor

runners.name: Control Room
runners.spotlight: Maiden winner at 5f; two good runs for Grace Harris, last time finding one too good at Nottingham (5f); the third was runner-up last weekend at Newmarket.
runners.comment: Two good runs for Grace Harris, last time finding one too good at Nottingham

runners.name: Rogue Bullet
runners.spotlight: Twice held since his winning debut for this yard at Brighton (extended 5f) but wasn't beaten far off this mark two runs ago; hard to dismiss.
runners.comment: Twice held since his winning debut for this yard at Brighton but can still run well

runners.name: Over Spiced
runners.spotlight: In a good run of form and did well to threaten from the widest stall at Chester last time (5f, good); player.
runners.comment: In a good run of form and did well to threaten from the widest stall at Chester last time

runners.name: Level Up
runners.spotlight: Exposed but very consistent and deserved to snap a losing streak over C&D recently when racing prominently and keeping on; back up 4lb.
runners.comment: Exposed but very consistent and deserved to snap a losing streak over C&D recently

runners.name: Alkuwarrior
runners.spotlight: A 2l winner in the new cheekpieces at Ffos Las but hasn't kicked on; behind Moe's Legacy latest.
runners.comment: 2l winner in new cheekpieces at Ffos Las but hasn't kicked on; behind Moe's Legacy latest

races.race_name: Happy Birthday Colin Spencer Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)

runners.name: Windbreaker
runners.spotlight: Looked mildly progressive when second on the AW (9.4f) but didn't improve for the cheekpieces at Newbury (1m2f), albeit under a forward ride (often held up); could leave that run behind.
runners.comment: Looked progressive until last time when he was ridden more forcefully than usual

runners.name: Talis Evolvere
runners.spotlight: Five of his six wins have been on the AW but consistent handicapper on all surfaces and ran well in a Class 3 at Doncaster latest (7f; fine at 1m); thereabouts.
runners.comment: Five of his six wins have been on the AW but consistent handicapper on all surfaces

runners.name: Revelance
runners.spotlight: Last year she won a Salisbury novice (7f, good to firm) and Epsom handicap (extended 1m, good to soft); yet to make a great impact this season, but it was a Class 3 last time at Ascot; on a competitive mark.
runners.comment: Dual winner on a competitive mark; could leave this season's two runs behind

runners.name: Serenity Blue
runners.spotlight: Dual novice winner last year and back to form in first-time cheekpieces when not quite getting home over 1m2f last time (runner-up won at the weekend); drops in trip with probably more to offer.
runners.comment: Back to form in first-time cheekpieces when not quite getting home over 1m2f last time

runners.name: Nakaaha
runners.spotlight: Won twice at 1m last summer and went in again at Bath last month (by just under 2l off 4lb lower); reportedly showing signs of heat stress when below par at Newbury four weeks ago.
runners.comment: Reportedly showing signs of heat stress when below par at Newbury four weeks ago

runners.name: Auburn Avenue
runners.spotlight: Third run for this yard when belatedly off the mark over 7f here 13 days ago; that was a Class 6 so likely to need more, though Millie Wonnacott's claim takes away 5lb of the 6lb rise.
runners.comment: Recent winner but over 7f and that was a Class 6; likely to need more

runners.name: Spirit Of The Bay
runners.spotlight: 4lb higher than for her recent Class 5 win over C&D and she posted an ordinary time; others preferred.
runners.comment: 4lb higher than for her recent Class 5 win over C&D and she posted an ordinary time

races.race_name: LSL Racing Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap

runners.name: Sydney Rock
runners.spotlight: Hasn't beaten a rival this year but the saddle slipped last week at Sandown when only 3-1; finished runner-up in all her runs last season; could bounce back.
runners.comment: Hasn't beaten a rival this year but the saddle slipped last week at Sandown when only 3-1

runners.name: Clementines Star
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced and has improved for stepping up to 7f without headgear, following her second at Southwell with an odds-on defeat of two rivals at Thirsk (good to firm); this mark might be okay for her handicap debut.
runners.comment: Recent odds-on winner and this mark might be okay for her handicap debut

runners.name: Espona Bay
runners.spotlight: Won over 7f at Wolverhampton in May and close up in next two races, at 1m and 7f; finished last at Lingfield 12 days ago but that was over 6f.
runners.comment: Backward step over 6f last time but had been in competitive form at 7f/1m

runners.name: Fullstop
runners.spotlight: An improved third in April over 7f but that's not been the springboard for anything better; opposable.
runners.comment: An improved third in April over 7f but that's not been the springboard for anything better

runners.name: Jackabi
runners.spotlight: Has raced freely in the past and the hood he wore when winning a maiden handicap here last time for Ian Williams (same colours) is now missing; that's a nagging worry but he's only 2lb higher.
runners.comment: A winner for Ian Williams here last time but the hood worn then is now missing

runners.name: Grand Vista
runners.spotlight: 0-7 but in first-time cheekpieces when keeping on well for third over a tad further at Ffos Las on Tuesday; may have more to offer.
runners.comment: In new cheekpieces when keeping on well for third over tad further at Ffos Las on Tuesday

runners.name: Sup Of Red
runners.spotlight: In fair form this season until just seventh of 12 in 7f Kempton handicap in May and off since; the break is a worry but she's capable of going well.
runners.comment: In fair form this season until just seventh of 12 in 7f Kempton handicap in May; off since

races.race_name: Chepstow Plant International Supports Chepstow Centenary Handicap

runners.name: Red Snapper
runners.spotlight: His form had dipped but in first-time blinkers he emerged from off a strong pace to collect by a length at Salisbury (6f, good to firm); Charlie Tucker rides again off a 3lb rise; chance if the headgear continues to help.
runners.comment: In first-time blinkers he emerged from off strong pace to collect by a length at Salisbury

runners.name: Eightthreeone
runners.spotlight: Successful handicap debut at Southwell (6f AW) in April and has performed generally okay in the meantime without looking ahead of his mark; however, has to be feared in a race with no depth.
runners.comment: AW winner; handicapped about right but still feared in a race with no depth

runners.name: Pull The Rug
runners.spotlight: 6f winner on good to soft for previous yard which she left for 21,000gns; fourth of six on stable debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm) but only beaten a little over 2l in a messy race.
runners.comment: Fourth of six on stable debut at Windsor (6f, good/firm) but only beaten a little over 2l

runners.name: Hallandale Beach
runners.spotlight: Better for the tongue-tie going on in his last three races and won comfortably here in late June (6f, good to firm); could deal with the 8lb rise.
runners.comment: Won comfortably here in late June; could deal with the 8lb rise
